stories.title: Russians attack community in Dnipropetrovsk region with aerial bombs: Four killed, three injured
stories.summary: Russian forces struck the Dubovyky community in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region with aerial bombs, killing four people and injuring three others.

stories.title: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke dies at age 29
stories.summary: The Memphis Grizzlies and Priority Sports announced the death of forward Brandon Clarke at age 29. No details about the circumstances of his death were immediately provided.

stories.title: Kuwait accuses Iran of sending armed Revolutionary Guard team to attack an island in nation
stories.summary: Kuwait accused Iran of dispatching an armed Revolutionary Guard team to attack a Kuwaiti island. Kuwait has faced repeated Iranian attacks during the war, with hostilities continuing even during a fragile ceasefire.

stories.title: Iran tells US to accept latest peace plan or face 'failure' of Middle East truce
stories.summary: Iran's chief negotiator demanded that Washington accept Tehran's latest peace proposal or risk the collapse of the Middle East truce. The statement followed President Trump's warning that the ceasefire was near failure, more than two months after US-Israeli strikes on Iran triggered the war.

stories.title: Trump’s Golden Dome missile shield estimated to cost $1.2 trillion
stories.summary: A nonpartisan federal agency estimated that President Trump's proposed "Golden Dome" national missile defense system would cost $1.2 trillion to build and maintain over the next 20 years.

stories.title: Air India crisis deepens ahead of final Ahmedabad crash report
stories.summary: Air India is grappling with a leadership vacuum and mounting financial losses as it awaits the final investigative report into a fatal crash in Ahmedabad, deepening the airline's operational crisis.

stories.title: A decade on, Trump returns to a stronger and more assertive China
stories.summary: An analysis describes China under President Xi Jinping as a stronger and more assertive global competitor than when Donald Trump first took office, with one analyst calling Beijing the most powerful rival the US has ever faced.

stories.title: Sensing an edge, Iran 'ready to gamble' it can outlast Trump
stories.summary: Analysts say Iran's leadership is betting it can outlast U.S. President Donald Trump in peace negotiations, even after the assassination of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei at the start of the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran. A shaky ceasefire is holding roughly two-and-a-half months into the conflict, though Trump has warned it may collapse.

stories.title: Despite anti-Israel chants in arena, Israel’s Noam Bettan advances to Eurovision final
stories.summary: Israeli singer Noam Bettan advanced to the Eurovision grand final despite anti-Israel chants from audience members in the arena. At least two activists were removed by security after interruptions during the performance in Vienna.

stories.title: UN condemns child death toll from Israel's West Bank operations
stories.summary: The United Nations condemned the death toll among children resulting from Israel's military operations in the West Bank. According to the UN, Israeli forces were responsible for 93% of children killed in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, since January 2025.

stories.title: Comoros transport strike disrupts capital after fuel price hike
stories.summary: A transport strike over fuel price increases disrupted Comoros' capital Moroni for a second consecutive day. Union officials reported that seven members were arrested after being summoned by the national gendarmerie.

stories.title: After nearly 9 years, Trump is landing in a totally different China. Is he ready?
stories.summary: President Trump is visiting China for the first time in nearly nine years, arriving amid the US-Iran war's disruption of global energy supplies and increased economic uncertainty. Analysts note China's global standing has strengthened considerably since Trump's previous trip to Beijing.

stories.title: Russians strike residential building in Kryvyi Rih: Two killed, infant among wounded
stories.summary: A Russian strike hit a residential building in Kryvyi Rih, Dnipropetrovsk region, killing at least two people. An infant was among the wounded in the attack.

stories.title: Watch: NEET UG 2026 cancelled, Govt orders CBI probe | Above the Fold | 12.05.2026
stories.summary: India's NEET UG 2026 medical entrance exam was cancelled following a paper leak, and the government ordered a CBI investigation. Other top stories included an AIADMK split in Tamil Nadu and political debate over appointments in West Bengal.

stories.title: Approximately 2 million jobs lost in Iran due to war as internet blackout enters fourth month - NYT
stories.summary: Approximately two million jobs have been lost in Iran as the country endures combined pressures from war, sanctions, and infrastructure damage, according to the New York Times. Businesses have been laying off workers while an internet blackout has continued for four months.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz, Azerbaijan's President Aliyev discuss peace efforts in Mideast: PMO
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev held a phone call to discuss regional developments and Middle East peace efforts. The two leaders also reaffirmed bilateral ties between Pakistan and Azerbaijan.

stories.title: ‘You cannot have it both ways’: Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi urges US to back regime change in Iran
stories.summary: Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi of Iran urged the United States to support regime change in Tehran, speaking at the POLITICO Security Summit in Washington. Pahlavi argued that Western governments had pursued a failed strategy of appeasement that emboldened the Iranian regime.

stories.title: Two survivors, one struggle: The Holocaust, the Nakba and Gaza
stories.summary: Nakba survivor Antoine Raffoul and Holocaust survivor Stephen Kapos discussed the war in Gaza, genocide, and the prospect of one democratic Palestine in a joint interview with The New Arab.

stories.title: South Carolina Republicans defy Trump’s demands for redistricting
stories.summary: South Carolina's Republican state senators defied President Trump's demands to redraw the state's congressional map. Senate Republican leader Shane Massey acknowledged likely consequences for resisting the president, following a Supreme Court decision that effectively weakened the Voting Rights Act.

stories.title: Major Palestinian gang running forgery ring uncovered in West Bank op. by IDF, Israel Police
stories.summary: Israeli security forces and police uncovered a major Palestinian forgery ring during an operation in the West Bank. The network produced counterfeit cards and documents that were sold to Palestinians seeking to illegally enter Israel.

stories.title: US attorney general defends press subpoenas over classified leaks
stories.summary: Acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche defended issuing subpoenas to journalists as part of investigations into classified information leaks. His remarks followed a Wall Street Journal report that the outlet had received grand jury subpoenas related to its Iran war coverage.

stories.title: US war in Iran has cost $36.9 billion so far: Pentagon
stories.summary: The US Pentagon reported that the war in Iran has cost $36.9 billion so far, up from $25 billion as of April 29.

stories.title: US war in Iran has cost $29 billion so far, Pentagon says
stories.summary: A senior Pentagon official said the U.S. war in Iran has cost $29 billion so far, an increase of $4 billion from an estimate provided in late April. The updated figure was disclosed on Tuesday.

stories.title: Conan O’Brien to return as Oscars host for third year in a row
stories.summary: Comedian Conan O'Brien will host the 99th Academy Awards in 2027, marking his third consecutive year as Oscars host. The Academy announced the decision after O'Brien received positive reviews for his previous two ceremonies despite a dip in viewership.

stories.title: 'Make a choice': Huckabee warns Gulf to choose between Iran and Israel
stories.summary: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee urged Gulf states to choose between Iran and Israel during an event in Tel Aviv promoting the Abraham Accords. He made the remarks alongside other senior U.S. and Israeli officials.

stories.title: Russia's plan in Kupiansk fails, but fighting on left bank of Oskil River continues – Trehubov
stories.summary: According to Ukrainian spokesperson Trehubov, Russian forces failed to achieve large-scale infiltration of Kupiansk in Kharkiv region. However, Russian troops maintain a limited presence in the city and continue attacking a bridgehead east of the Oskil River.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia covertly launched strikes on Iran during war, sources say
stories.summary: Sources report that Saudi Arabia covertly carried out strikes against Iran during the ongoing war, described as retaliation for Iranian attacks on the kingdom. The UAE also reportedly struck Iran before and after a truce, with at least one attack allegedly coordinated with Israel.

stories.title: Zelensky’s former chief of staff denies money laundering charges
stories.summary: Former Ukrainian presidential chief of staff Andriy Yermak denied money laundering charges brought against him in court proceedings.

stories.title: Starmer hopes to regain momentum with unveiling of dozens of bills in king’s speech
stories.summary: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer plans to announce 35 bills in the King's Speech, covering housing, immigration, and energy. The legislative package comes as Starmer faces internal party revolt with Labour MPs demanding his resignation.

stories.title: Trump’s ‘art of the deal’ playbook is failing as Beijing asserts itself
stories.summary: President Trump is set to arrive in Beijing for a high-stakes summit amid what analysts describe as a failing "maximum pressure" strategy. The visit, delayed by the Iran war, comes as Trump's administration faces multiple domestic crises including pressure from the approaching 2026 midterms.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia launched secret attacks on Iran during Middle East war
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia carried out previously unreported military strikes on Iranian soil during the broader Middle East conflict. The attacks mark the first known instance of the kingdom directly conducting military action against Iran, signaling a more assertive Saudi posture.

stories.title: Trump-class Battleship will get same nuclear reactor as Ford aircraft carrier
stories.summary: Chief of Naval Operations Admiral Daryl Caudle confirmed that the planned Trump-class battleship will use the same nuclear reactor design as the USS Gerald Ford aircraft carrier. The battleship will share several additional design features with the Ford-class carrier.

stories.title: Iran says ceasefire terms meet minimum standards for lasting peace
stories.summary: Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi defended Tehran's ceasefire proposal, describing it as meeting the minimum requirements for a serious and sustainable peace agreement aligned with the UN Charter. He condemned Washington's rejection of the plan, alleging it reveals a broader agenda.

stories.title: French hantavirus patient critically ill, put on an artificial lung
stories.summary: A French woman infected with hantavirus during a cruise ship outbreak is critically ill and receiving treatment with an artificial lung at a Paris hospital. The outbreak has produced 11 reported cases, with three deaths including a Dutch couple believed to have been first exposed in South America.

stories.title: What Happened to Trump the China Hawk?
stories.summary: President Trump is heading to Beijing in a conciliatory posture, shifting from his earlier hawkish stance on China. The visit signals a focus on détente and dealmaking rather than confrontation.

stories.title: Basketball star Brandon Clarke, Memphis Grizzlies forward, dies at age 29
stories.summary: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke died at age 29. Neither the team nor his agency, Priority Sports, released details about the cause of death.

stories.title: 'Gray zone' on some parts of front stretches for up to 10 kilometers – Trehubov
stories.summary: Ukrainian spokesperson Trehubov reported that the so-called "gray zone" on some front-line sectors has expanded to as much as 10 kilometers due to widespread drone use. The expanded strike zone has complicated Russian advances and helped Ukrainian forces retain control of several settlements.

stories.title: Russian strike kills 6 in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region, wounds infant who loses leg
stories.summary: Russian strikes on Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region killed six people, according to the regional military administration. An infant was among the wounded and lost a leg in the attack.

stories.title: UNICEF says 70 children killed in West Bank and East Jerusalem since 2025
stories.summary: UNICEF reported that 70 children have been killed in the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem since early 2025, averaging approximately one per week. More than 800 children have been injured in the same period, the agency said Tuesday in Geneva.

stories.title: Budget 2026 live updates: Coalition pledges to repeal Chalmers’ tax reforms amid mixed reception for ‘difficult’ budget
stories.summary: Australia's 2026 federal budget included major reforms to negative gearing and capital gains tax, prompting the Coalition to pledge repeal of the changes. Shadow Treasurer Tim Wilson said his objective is to defeat the proposed tax reforms.

stories.title: Knesset advances in first reading bill to form Israeli antiquities authority in West Bank
stories.summary: The Israeli Knesset advanced a bill in its first reading that would transfer authority over antiquities in the West Bank from the Defense Ministry to the Heritage Ministry. The proposed legislation would establish a formal Israeli antiquities authority operating in the territory.

stories.title: Trump 'could choose to change Taiwan policy in Beijing' unhindered by Congress, analyst says
stories.summary: Analyst David Sacks of the Council on Foreign Relations stated that President Trump could unilaterally alter U.S. policy toward Taiwan during his meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing, with limited ability for Congress to intervene. The two leaders are holding talks on Thursday and Friday where Taiwan is expected to be a central topic.

stories.title: Irish writer calls public broadcaster’s decision not to air Eurovision ‘antisemitic’
stories.summary: Irish writer Graham Linehan accused Ireland's public broadcaster RTÉ of making an "antisemitic political gesture" by choosing not to air the Eurovision contest. RTÉ planned to broadcast an episode of "Father Ted" instead, though Linehan said he did not authorize the use of his work.

stories.title: Trump downplays US-Iran differences as he heads to Beijing to meet with Xi
stories.summary: President Donald Trump sent mixed signals about the role of the US-Iran war in his upcoming talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing, with his administration placing greater emphasis on trade issues.

stories.title: High Court demands documents to review Mossad chief’s appointment, but unsure it can intervene
stories.summary: Israel's High Court ordered the submission of documents to review the appointment of Roman Gofman as Mossad chief. Justices questioned why key issues were not raised by the selection panel and ordered an IDF officer to file an affidavit addressing claims Gofman lied to the army.

stories.title: Gilad Kariv warns of potential violence during Jerusalem Day flag march
stories.summary: Israeli lawmaker Gilad Kariv warned of potential violence during the annual Jerusalem Day flag march. In a letter, Kariv noted that the march and its culminating rally at the Western Wall have become associated with acts of violence, hatred, and racism in recent years.

stories.title: US court pauses decision blocking Trump’s 10 percent global tariff
stories.summary: A US court paused a ruling that had blocked President Trump's 10 percent global tariff. A coalition of 24 states had challenged the tariffs, arguing they do not meet the legal standards set by the 1974 Trade Act.

stories.title: Zelensky: Ukraine responds in kind to Russian strikes, targets gas facilities in Orenburg region
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine is striking Russian gas industry facilities in the Orenburg region, more than 1,500 km from Ukraine, in response to ongoing Russian attacks on Ukrainian territory.

stories.title: Islamic State claims deadly attack on Syrian government forces
stories.summary: Islamic State claimed responsibility for an attack in eastern Syria on Tuesday that killed two Syrian army soldiers. The group said it was its first deadly operation against Syrian government forces since February.

stories.title: Cannes juror denounces Hollywood boycott of actors for Gaza war views
stories.summary: At the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, juror and screenwriter Paul Laverty publicly criticized Hollywood for boycotting actors who have spoken out against the war in Gaza.

stories.title: US expects Iran oil output to fall amid blockade
stories.summary: The U.S. Energy Information Administration projected that Iran's oil production will decline due to the American blockade on Iranian ports. The agency said output and trade flows are unlikely to return to prewar levels until late 2026 or early 2027, warning that extended closure of the Strait of Hormuz could drive global prices significantly higher.

stories.title: Ukrainian drones halted Russia’s spring advance. Russia is bombing back.
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone operations have slowed Russia's spring military advance, but Russia has responded with intensified bombing campaigns. Both sides are racing to deplete each other's forces and resources along the front lines.

stories.title: US defence secretary joins Trump on China trip in rare diplomatic move
stories.summary: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth joined President Trump aboard Air Force One for a state visit to Beijing, becoming the first American defense chief in decades to accompany a president on such a trip to China. Trump is scheduled to hold bilateral talks with President Xi Jinping on Thursday and Friday.

stories.title: Trump announces talks with ‘failed’ Cuba
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump announced talks with Cuba, which he described as a "failed country." Cuba has been severely affected by a US fuel blockade imposed in connection with Washington's actions in Venezuela.

stories.title: Sudan: UN Warns Sudan War Entering 'Deadlier Phase' As Drone Strikes Kill Hundreds, Attacks Spread Across Multiple Regions
stories.summary: The United Nations warned that Sudan's war is entering a "deadlier phase" as drone strikes, artillery shelling, displacement camp fires, and intercommunal violence intensify across multiple regions including Khartoum, Omdurman, El Obeid, and El Goz locality.

stories.title: New York Times article details brutal rape of Palestinians. Israel calls it 'blood libel'
stories.summary: New York Times columnist Nicholas Kristof published an article detailing accounts of brutal sexual violence against Palestinians, based on testimony gathered during a trip to the occupied West Bank. Israel's government condemned the report as "blood libel."

stories.title: US, close allies creating joint ‘orbital warfare’ plan: SPACECOM chief
stories.summary: US Space Command chief Gen. Stephen Whiting told the Mitchell Institute that the US and close allies are developing a joint orbital warfare plan. Whiting also announced that SPACECOM intends to conduct quarterly Apollo Insights tabletop exercises with commercial space industry partners.

stories.title: US confirms Israel sent Iron Dome batteries to UAE
stories.summary: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee confirmed that Israel sent Iron Dome air defense batteries and military personnel to the UAE amid the ongoing conflict with Iran. He cited the move as evidence of the deepening relationship between Israel and the UAE under the Abraham Accords.

stories.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1539: Ukraine and the US are preparing a landmark “Drone Deal” on manufacturing and exports
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone forces destroyed two long-range Russian radar systems in Donetsk Oblast capable of detecting targets at distances up to 300 km. The UK, EU, and Canada imposed new sanctions on Russian networks linked to the deportation of over 20,000 Ukrainian children. Ukraine and the U.S. are also preparing a landmark agreement on drone manufacturing and exports.

stories.title: Hegseth: Pentagon is ‘taking another look’ at deep cuts to Army’s aircraft budget
stories.summary: Secretary of Defense Hegseth said the Pentagon is reconsidering proposed deep cuts to the Army's aircraft budget. Lawmakers had raised concerns about the Army's budget proposal, which significantly reduced procurement of legacy helicopter programs.

stories.title: Karachi police arrest 'most-wanted' female drug lord
stories.summary: Karachi police arrested Anmol, alias Pinki, a woman described as a most-wanted suspect accused of supplying cocaine and other narcotics across the city. The operation was conducted jointly by Garden Police Station officers and a civilian intelligence agency.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron wants dialogue with Rwanda and DRC
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron, in an interview with FRANCE 24, RFI, and TV5Monde, urged dialogue with both Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of Congo rather than rushing to isolate Rwanda following American moves to do so. He argued that isolation would reduce the chances of securing Rwandan cooperation.

stories.title: Defense contractors have donated millions to members of Congress, new report finds
stories.summary: A new report from OpenSecrets found that US defense contractors have donated millions of dollars to members of Congress. However, the report noted that these defense industry contributions represent only a small fraction of the total campaign cash flowing to lawmakers.

stories.title: Ukraine's PM, Spain's parliamentary speaker discuss energy, Special Tribunal for Russia
stories.summary: Ukraine's Prime Minister met with the speaker of Spain's parliament to discuss energy cooperation. Kyiv is seeking Spain's ratification of agreements on the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine and the International Claims Commission for Ukraine.

stories.title: What Trump and Xi Want From Their Summit
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are preparing for a summit expected to cover trade, Taiwan, and the ongoing war involving Iran.

stories.title: PMDC says medical students must qualify for MDCAT, obtain registration before going abroad
stories.summary: Pakistan's Medical and Dental Council announced that students seeking medical or dental education abroad must first pass the MDCAT and obtain registration. A high-level committee chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar is overseeing reforms to the regulatory framework.

stories.title: Reservists Party launches national PTSD recovery plan for those impacted by war, October 7
stories.summary: Israel's Reservists Party unveiled a national PTSD recovery plan for individuals affected by the ongoing war and the October 7 attacks. Party leader Hendel presented the plan at a press conference alongside reservists who suffered physical and psychological injuries in combat.

stories.title: How Netanyahu's battle with legal system may shape future of Mossad, Shin Bet, IDF - analysis
stories.summary: An analysis examines how Prime Minister Netanyahu's conflicts with Israel's legal system could affect the future leadership and oversight of the Mossad, Shin Bet, and IDF. A central question is whether the High Court will address concerns about a key appointee's ability to ethically manage intelligence operations.

stories.title: So many Ukrainian AI drones are hunting Russian trucks they’re crossing each other’s paths
stories.summary: Ukraine has deployed large numbers of AI-guided autonomous drones to target Russian logistics vehicles behind the front lines. Reports indicate so many drones are operating in the Russian logistical zone that they are crossing each other's flight paths.

stories.title: Trump backs Pakistan as Iran mediator after criticism from Lindsey Graham
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump expressed support for Pakistan serving as a mediator between Washington and Tehran. However, Republican Senator Lindsey Graham publicly voiced distrust of Pakistan's ability to facilitate Iran diplomacy.

stories.title: Deals and new partnerships at Africa-France summit
stories.summary: At the Africa Forward summit in Nairobi, Kenyan President William Ruto emphasized sovereignty as a central theme. Separately, Rwanda-backed M23 rebels retreated from territory they had seized in the DRC, marking the most significant ground shift in months. Zimbabwe's horticulture sector is also facing rising shipping costs linked to the war in Iran.

stories.title: Pakistan to face growing health risk as international funding to health sector continues to decline: report
stories.summary: A report titled "Beyond Dependence" warned that Pakistan faces serious health risks as international funding to its health sector declines, with major foreign donors expected to suspend grants entirely by 2030. The report was prepared by the think tank Tabadlab.

stories.title: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon kill civilians and rescue workers
stories.summary: Israeli strikes in the Nabatieh area of south Lebanon killed several civilians and rescue workers, according to Lebanon's National News Agency. Three people were killed in a strike on Jebchit, including a Lebanese army first sergeant. A separate Israeli drone strike near a Civil Defence Centre in Nabatieh al-Fouqa killed another man.

stories.title: Ukraine's president, Spain's parliamentary speaker discuss defense cooperation
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky and Speaker of Spain's Congress of Deputies Francina Armengol discussed defense cooperation, including air defense and the development of the PURL and SAFE programs.

stories.title: Hungary PM Magyar gives veto power to key ministers in his cabinet following new EU sanctions
stories.summary: Hungary's new Prime Minister Peter Magyar and his cabinet ministers were sworn into office. Magyar granted veto power to key ministers in his government following the European Union's imposition of new sanctions on Hungary.

stories.title: Covid-era conspiracy theories accuse Bill Gates of ‘creating’ hantavirus outbreak
stories.summary: Confirmed hantavirus cases aboard the Dutch-flagged cruise ship MV Hondius have reached nine. The outbreak has triggered a resurgence of Covid-19-era conspiracy theories on social media, with users alleging bioweapons and planned pandemics. American billionaire Bill Gates has again become a prominent target of these unfounded claims.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron’s speaks about France's policies in Sahel countries
stories.summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, RFI, and TV5Monde, French President Emmanuel Macron reflected on France's relations with Sahel countries. He acknowledged that France should have engaged in challenging dialogue sooner and reconsidered its military presence in the region earlier.

stories.title: Drone boats make debut in Navy’s 30-year shipbuilding plan
stories.summary: The U.S. Navy's latest 30-year shipbuilding plan includes unmanned drone boats for the first time. Service officials envision building toward a 450-hull fleet by 2031.

stories.title: Beijing calls Paraguay leaders willing ‘chess pieces’ after disputed Taiwan trip
stories.summary: Beijing condemned Paraguayan President Santiago Peña's four-day visit to Taiwan, calling Paraguayan leaders willing "chess pieces" for Taiwanese independence forces. China's foreign ministry urged Paraguay to recognize the one-China principle and "change course."

stories.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
stories.summary: Lebanon's health ministry reported that 13 people, including two paramedics, were killed in Israeli strikes on Nabatieh. The paramedics were responding to a rescue mission following an earlier attack that had killed one person.

stories.title: Why have peace efforts failed to end conflict in Sudan?
stories.summary: Peace efforts to end Sudan's civil war have repeatedly failed. The United Nations has warned that the increasing use of drones by warring parties is making the conflict significantly more dangerous.

stories.title: SAPO: Yermak holds four diplomatic passports, border crossing data deleted from system
stories.summary: Ukraine's Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office revealed that former Presidential Office head Andriy Yermak holds four diplomatic passports. Data on his state border crossings since November 20, 2025, was found to have been deleted from the Arkan border-monitoring system.

stories.title: Red Cross says people displaced by conflict in Colombia doubled last year
stories.summary: The International Committee of the Red Cross reported that the number of people displaced by conflict in Colombia doubled in the past year. The ICRC's annual report cited worsening conditions for civilians due to continued fighting among armed groups.

stories.title: Trump’s Golden Dome to cost US$1.2 trillion, may fail to stop all-out attack: watchdog
stories.summary: The nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office estimated that President Trump's proposed "Golden Dome" missile defense shield could cost up to $1.2 trillion to deploy and operate — six times above current forecasts. The watchdog also assessed that the system would likely fail to stop an all-out attack.

stories.title: Does OPEC Still Matter?
stories.summary: The United Arab Emirates announced on April 28 that it would leave OPEC effective May 1, ending nearly six decades of membership. The UAE is the most significant oil-producing country to depart the group. The timing coincides with the war involving Iran and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, which have intensified global focus on oil prices.

stories.title: Trump dismisses China role on Iran and claims US victory
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump dismissed the idea that China could play a role in resolving the conflict with Iran, stating the US would prevail independently. Speaking before a planned visit to China to meet President Xi Jinping, Trump said Washington would win "peacefully or otherwise."

stories.title: Japanese crisp bags turn black and white due to Iran war
stories.summary: Brent crude oil prices climbed near $110 a barrel as a standoff over the Strait of Hormuz continues, with the US and Iran each rejecting the other's ceasefire proposal. Japanese snack manufacturer Calbee temporarily switched some product packaging to black and white due to supply disruptions in petrochemical-based printing ink.

stories.title: India’s Hindu extremist group RSS lobbies foreign groups to counter minority rights criticism
stories.summary: India's Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh said it organised foreign visits, including to the United States, to counter perceptions that it is a paramilitary group involved in attacks on minorities. The outreach followed a US Commission on International Religious Freedom report criticising the RSS.

stories.title: China presses Pakistan to deepen Iran mediation ahead of Trump-Xi talks
stories.summary: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi urged Pakistan to intensify its mediation efforts in the Iran crisis during a call with Pakistani counterpart Ishaq Dar. The push came ahead of President Trump's visit to Beijing, as the Iran conflict threatened to overshadow U.S.-China talks.

stories.title: Mali, immigration and DR Congo: Five key takeaways from Macron's interview with FRANCE 24
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron gave an interview to FRANCE 24 at the conclusion of the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi, Kenya. He addressed topics including Mali, immigration, and the Democratic Republic of Congo, outlining his views on France's evolving relationship with African nations.

stories.title: Why is Iran increasingly targeting the UAE in its war messaging?
stories.summary: Iran has increasingly directed hostile rhetoric toward the United Arab Emirates in its war messaging. Analysts attribute this to the UAE's close ties with both the United States and Israel, which have drawn Iranian suspicion.

stories.title: Kash Patel denies excessive drinking allegations as ‘total farce’ in Senate hearing
stories.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel denied allegations of excessive drinking and unexplained absences during a Senate hearing, calling the claims a "total farce." Democrats challenged him over reports first published in the Atlantic, which Patel has sued over.

stories.title: Ukraine hits Russia’s distant gas facilities after Moscow’s attacks kill 6
stories.summary: Ukraine struck distant Russian gas facilities in retaliation for Russian attacks that killed at least six people in Ukraine. President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed the strikes were a direct response to Moscow's targeting of Ukrainian territory.

stories.title: US confirms Israel sent Iron Dome batteries to UAE
stories.summary: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee confirmed that Israel sent Iron Dome air defense batteries to the United Arab Emirates. The deployment highlights growing Israeli-Emirati military coordination amid the ongoing war against Iran.

stories.title: Ukraine, partners launch initiative to form anti-ballistic coalition – Zelensky
stories.summary: President Zelensky announced that Ukraine and European partners are advancing the creation of an anti-ballistic coalition and the production of anti-ballistic systems in Europe. Representatives from 13 countries and the NATO Secretary General's office participated in a meeting of national security advisors.

stories.title: UK promises jets, drones and warship for Strait of Hormuz defence mission
stories.summary: The United Kingdom has committed jets, drones, and a warship to a multinational defence mission in the Strait of Hormuz. More than 40 nations are participating in the effort, which the UK Ministry of Defence says will launch when conditions permit.

stories.title: China’s Rare-Earth Card Looms Over Trump-Xi Summit
stories.summary: Ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, analysts highlight China's dominance in rare-earth minerals as a significant point of leverage. Despite US efforts to reduce dependencies, Washington remains deeply vulnerable to potential Chinese restrictions on these critical materials.

stories.title: Eurovision Song Contest gets off to a tense start, overshadowed by Gaza
stories.summary: The Eurovision Song Contest began its first semi-final in Vienna on Tuesday amid tensions over Israel's participation, which prompted five countries to boycott the event. A protest was planned hours before the broadcast.

stories.title: Kremlin repeats Putin’s assertion that Ukraine war is nearly over after Zelensky casts doubt
stories.summary: The Kremlin reiterated President Putin's claim that the Ukraine war is nearly over after President Zelenskyy expressed skepticism. The warring sides had observed a short U.S.-mediated ceasefire from May 9 to 11.

stories.title: American actor Jane Fonda and Chinese star Gong Li open 2026 Cannes Film Festival
stories.summary: The 2026 Cannes Film Festival opened on Tuesday with American actor Jane Fonda and Chinese star Gong Li presenting the ceremony. New Zealand director Peter Jackson, known for the Lord of the Rings trilogy, received an honorary Palme d'Or for his career.

stories.title: Trump announces talks with 'failed' Cuba
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump announced talks with Cuba, describing the communist-ruled island as a "failed country" in a Truth Social post. Cuba has been severely affected by a fuel blockade imposed by Washington following the capture of former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.

stories.title: Amid inflation pressure, Trump promises oil price drop after war ends
stories.summary: President Donald Trump pledged that oil prices would drop sharply once the war ends, as his administration faces mounting domestic pressure over conflict-driven inflation. Trump linked rising consumer costs to disruptions in global energy supply and predicted a stock market surge after hostilities cease.

stories.title: When it comes to Oct. 7, the New York Times prefers baseless claims over actual reports - editorial
stories.summary: An editorial criticizes the New York Times for relying on unsubstantiated claims regarding events of October 7 rather than documented reports. The piece notes that even the columnist in question acknowledged the difficulty of verifying the prevalence of the alleged incidents.

stories.title: Cambridge AS-level Mathematics paper allegedly leaked, students claim
stories.summary: Students in Pakistan claimed that a Cambridge AS-level Mathematics exam paper was leaked, alleging the test they sat matched a solved paper circulated on social media the day before. Cambridge International Education administers exams in over 160 countries.

stories.title: Starmer is toast. To stop Farage now, Britain's left-wing forces must unite
stories.summary: Following a poor electoral performance, UK Labour Party leader Keir Starmer faces calls to step aside. Commentators argue Labour must select a new leader capable of uniting left-wing and progressive forces to counter the rise of Nigel Farage's Reform UK.

stories.title: Islamophobia, racist threats, Holocaust denial: Comments by newly-elected Reform councillors
stories.summary: Several newly elected Reform UK councillors faced backlash over alleged Islamophobic, racist, and Holocaust-denying comments found online. Some of the councillors stepped down following the revelations. The controversy emerged shortly after Reform made gains in local elections.

stories.title: Hezbollah chief says group’s weapons not part of talks with Israel
stories.summary: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem stated that the group's weapons are not part of any negotiations with Israel and are purely an internal Lebanese matter. He also vowed that Hezbollah fighters would turn the battlefield into "hell" for Israeli forces.

stories.title: Trump’s ‘Golden Dome’ missile shield to cost $1.2 trillion, far more than planned
stories.summary: A Congressional estimate puts the cost of President Trump's proposed "Golden Dome" missile defense shield at $1.2 trillion, far exceeding the initial $175 billion price tag. Trump had previously said the system would be operational by the end of his term in 2029.

stories.title: Farmers urge policy shift on foot-and-mouth outbreak as farms become overcrowded
stories.summary: Israeli farmers are calling for a revised risk assessment and financial compensation amid a foot-and-mouth disease outbreak causing overcrowding on farms. Agricultural cooperatives have criticized new Agriculture Ministry guidelines as inadequate for addressing the crisis.

stories.title: Asia Isn’t as Peaceful as It Seems
stories.summary: Analysts warn that security conditions across Asia may be less stable than commonly perceived. Eroding norms against the use of military force are raising concerns about potential future conflicts in the region.

stories.title: Russian FPV drone attacks energy facility in Kramatorsk district
stories.summary: A Russian first-person-view drone struck a critical infrastructure energy facility in the Kramatorsk district of Donetsk region on Tuesday.

stories.title: Starmer faces calls to quit: “Step aside or give No 10 to Nigel Farage,” says former Labour adviser
stories.summary: Nearly 90 Labour MPs are calling on UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer to resign following poor local election results, while several cabinet members have also stepped down. However, 110 Labour MPs have signed a statement backing him. Starmer argues his departure would create chaos for the country.

stories.title: Macron unveils $27 billion Africa investment, urges reset with Europe
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron announced a $27 billion investment package for Africa at the Africa Forward summit in Kenya. He called for a "fundamental reset" in relations between the continent and Europe.

stories.title: 'Cultural genocide': Palestinian musicians urge Eurovision boycott over Israel's inclusion
stories.summary: Palestinian musicians called for a boycott of the Eurovision Song Contest over Israel's continued participation while the conflict in Gaza persists. Artists from Gaza and the occupied West Bank said their culture was being destroyed and urged viewers to support the #VoteJustice4Palestine campaign.

stories.title: Trump skirts question on US ‘red lines’ for Iran ceasefire
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump avoided answering a reporter's question about whether he has established any "red lines" that would end the ceasefire with Iran. Trump declined to specify conditions under which negotiations might collapse.

stories.title: Finland to Tighten Curbs on Medical Equipment Exports to Russia
stories.summary: Finland announced plans to tighten restrictions on medical equipment exports to Russia after officials determined that medical and pharmaceutical products may be diverted for Russian military use.

stories.title: Online safety campaigners reveal Starmer frustrations after Phillips exit
stories.summary: Online safety campaigners expressed frustration with UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer's handling of efforts to force tech companies to block child abuse imagery on children's phones. Labour MP Jess Phillips resigned from government, citing stalled progress, joining over 80 MPs calling for Starmer to step down.

stories.title: Price tag for Iran war ticks up to $29B, not including base damage
stories.summary: Pentagon officials confirmed the Iran war's cost has reached $29 billion, excluding military construction expenses for damaged bases. Comptroller Jules Hurst said the Department of Defense cannot yet estimate construction costs because future posture decisions remain undetermined.

stories.title: Watch: Macron speaks to FRANCE 24 as Africa Forward Summit wraps up
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron spoke to France 24 as the Africa Forward Summit concluded. No further details on the content of his remarks were provided.

stories.title: Haredi factions back dissolving Knesset, increasing chance for early elections
stories.summary: Haredi political factions in Israel have expressed support for dissolving the Knesset, increasing the likelihood of early elections. Degel HaTorah's spiritual leader cited lost trust in Prime Minister Netanyahu over failure to pass a military exemption bill. The move would require support from the Shas party to proceed.

stories.title: Pentagon says US cost of Iran war approaching $29 billion
stories.summary: The US Pentagon informed Congress that the cost of the war with Iran is approaching $29 billion, reflecting a $4 billion increase from prior estimates due to equipment maintenance. Democratic lawmakers have accused the White House of opaque and ineffective spending on the conflict.

stories.title: UK military build-up in Gulf raises fears of escalation
stories.summary: The United Kingdom announced a significant military deployment to the Strait of Hormuz, including mine-hunting drones, Typhoon fighter jets, and the warship HMS Dragon. Defence Secretary John Healey made the announcement during a meeting with defense ministers from over 40 countries, raising concerns about potential UK involvement in the Israel-US war against Iran.

stories.title: Trump heads to Beijing seeking stability in high-stakes Xi talks
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump departed for China for a summit with President Xi Jinping, his first visit to Beijing since 2017. The talks aim to stabilize relations between the two largest economies amid ongoing disputes over trade, Taiwan, and global security.

stories.title: Russian Regions Move Schools Online Amid Drone Attack Fears
stories.summary: Officials in at least four Russian regions moved schools to online instruction on Monday and Tuesday, citing security concerns related to the threat of Ukrainian drone attacks.

stories.title: Would We Be Better Off Today With the JCPOA?
stories.summary: The ongoing US-Iran war has reignited debate over whether the 2015 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action nuclear deal, from which the US withdrew, could have prevented the current conflict. The question remains one of Washington's most contentious counterfactuals.

stories.title: Montenegro, Romania, San Marino to join agreement on Special Tribunal for Crime of Aggression against Ukraine
stories.summary: Montenegro, Romania, and San Marino have notified the Council of Europe of their intention to join the agreement establishing a Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine.

stories.title: Ecuador's Espinosa joins battle to lead United Nations
stories.summary: Antigua and Barbuda nominated Ecuador's Maria Fernanda Espinosa as a candidate for the next United Nations Secretary-General. The nomination was confirmed by a UN official on Tuesday in Geneva.

stories.title: Trump visit sees Marco Rubio become first sanctioned US secretary of state to visit China
stories.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is also serving as National Security Adviser, traveled to Beijing with President Trump despite being under Chinese sanctions. Rubio becomes the first sitting U.S. Secretary of State sanctioned by China to visit the country.

stories.title: Kremlin repeats Putin's assertion that Ukraine war is nearly over after Zelenskyy casts doubt
stories.summary: The Kremlin reiterated President Vladimir Putin's claim that the war in Ukraine is nearing its end, despite Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy casting doubt on Russia's intentions to end the conflict. Kyiv has accused Moscow of having no genuine intention to cease hostilities.

stories.title: Russia’s presidential human rights council head says banning VPNs is impossible, warns shutdown could break the internet
stories.summary: Valery Fadeev, head of Russia's presidential Human Rights Council, said banning VPN services is technically impossible and warned that attempting to shut them down could disrupt the broader internet.

stories.title: Rana stars as Bangladesh down Pakistan in 1st Test thriller
stories.summary: Bangladesh defeated Pakistan by 104 runs in the first Test in Dhaka, taking a 1-0 lead in the two-match series. Pace bowler Nahid Rana took five wickets, while Pakistan's debutant Abdullah Fazal scored 66 in a losing effort. It was Bangladesh's first home Test victory over Pakistan.

stories.title: Qatar says Iran should not use Hormuz to 'blackmail' Gulf
stories.summary: Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani stated that Iran should not use the Strait of Hormuz as a weapon to pressure or blackmail Gulf countries.

stories.title: Albrecht Weinberg, who survived several camps during Holocaust, dies at 101
stories.summary: Albrecht Weinberg, a Holocaust survivor who endured several concentration camps, died at the age of 101. Weinberg had returned to Germany 14 years ago after living in New York and spent his later years sharing his experiences with high school students.

stories.title: Hezbollah chief: Iran-US deal is best chance to end Israeli ‘aggression’ in Lebanon
stories.summary: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem stated in a letter to the group's operatives that a US-Iran deal represents the best opportunity to end what he called Israeli aggression in Lebanon. Qassem criticized the Lebanese government's direct negotiations with Israel and insisted Hezbollah's weapons must not be part of any discussions.

stories.title: Russia says Sarmat missile system successfully tested, to be placed on combat duty by year’s end
stories.summary: Russia announced a successful test of the Sarmat intercontinental ballistic missile system. Strategic Missile Forces commander Sergei Karakayev reported to President Putin that the system will be placed on combat duty by year's end.

stories.title: Turkey urges Iran-US deal and warns against new shipping restrictions
stories.summary: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan urged Iran and the United States to reach a lasting agreement, warning that continued fighting risks wider instability. Speaking to Al Jazeera, Fidan said both sides appear willing to end the conflict but cautioned the situation remains volatile and could escalate.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian command posts, depots, repair units in occupied territories
stories.summary: On the night of May 11–12, Ukrainian forces struck Russian command posts, logistics facilities, and troop concentrations in temporarily occupied areas of Donetsk, Luhansk, and Zaporizhzhia regions.

stories.title: Marty Makary departs FDA after clashes with Trump over fruit-flavored vapes
stories.summary: Marty Makary resigned as US Food and Drug Administration commissioner after 13 months marked by clashes with the White House, including disputes over fruit-flavored vapes. Kyle Diamantas, a senior FDA food policy official, is expected to serve as acting commissioner.

stories.title: UN condemns child death toll from Israel’s West Bank operations
stories.summary: The United Nations children's agency condemned the child death toll from Israel's military operations in the West Bank, stating that most of those killed or wounded were hit by live ammunition.

stories.title: Israel sent Iron Dome batteries, personnel to UAE: U.S. ambassador to Israel
stories.summary: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee revealed that Israel sent Iron Dome air-defense batteries and personnel to the United Arab Emirates. Huckabee cited the deployment as evidence of the strengthened relationship between the two countries under the Abraham Accords framework.

stories.title: Epstein survivors give tearful testimony in House field hearing in Palm Beach
stories.summary: House Oversight Committee Democrats held a field hearing in Palm Beach, Florida, where survivors of Jeffrey Epstein's abuse gave tearful testimony about their experiences. Lawmakers revealed new details about Epstein's international sex trafficking ring and warned President Trump against pardoning Ghislaine Maxwell.

stories.title: Golden Dome-style missile shield could cost up to $1.2T over 20 years, CBO estimates
stories.summary: The Congressional Budget Office estimated that a missile defense shield modeled on the proposed Golden Dome system could cost up to $1.2 trillion over 20 years. The CBO noted that a precise estimate is impossible because the Department of Defense has not disclosed architectural details.

stories.title: Russia Slates Sarmat ICBM Deployment for Late 2026
stories.summary: Russia announced it plans to deploy the Sarmat intercontinental ballistic missile by late 2026, following what the military described as a successful test launch on Tuesday.

stories.title: Nine-month-old girl lost a leg, at least six killed as Russia strikes Kryvyi Rih and Dnipropetrovsk Oblast
stories.summary: A Russian Shahed drone struck a residential building in Kryvyi Rih in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, killing at least six people. A nine-month-old girl lost a leg in the attack, according to local officials.

stories.title: Iran: Surge of political prisoners amid US-Israel war
stories.summary: Iran is reportedly intensifying repression of political prisoners amid its ongoing conflict with the United States and Israel. Advocates have raised alarms about mass executions as international attention remains focused on the Strait of Hormuz standoff.

stories.title: Russian e-book platforms add drug-use warnings to classic books, including ‘The Hobbit’ and ‘Peter Pan’
stories.summary: Major Russian e-book platforms including Litres and Ozon have begun adding drug-use warnings to classic children's literature, including translations of "The Hobbit" and "Peter Pan."

stories.title: IDF indicts two soldiers for smuggling cigarettes, stealing ammo, tax offenses linked with Gaza
stories.summary: The Israel Defense Forces indicted two soldiers holding the rank of Sergeant First Class for smuggling cigarettes, stealing ammunition, and committing tax offenses including money laundering in connection with operations in Gaza.

stories.title: Kevin Warsh confirmed to US Federal Reserve board in close Senate vote
stories.summary: Kevin Warsh was confirmed to the US Federal Reserve board following a narrow Senate vote. Democratic Senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania crossed party lines to join Republicans in supporting Warsh's confirmation.

stories.title: Iran now defines Strait of Hormuz as far larger zone, IRGC officer says
stories.summary: A senior Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy officer said Iran has expanded its definition of the Strait of Hormuz into a "vast operational area" significantly wider than before the Iran war. The announcement was made from Dubai on May 12.

stories.title: Karachi police arrest 'highly wanted' female drug lord
stories.summary: Karachi police arrested a woman identified as Anmol, alias Pinki, described as a highly wanted suspect accused of supplying cocaine and other narcotics across the city. The operation was conducted jointly by Garden Police Station officers and a civilian intelligence agency after midnight on Tuesday.

stories.title: Africa Forward summit wraps up in Nairobi
stories.summary: The Africa Forward summit, co-hosted by Kenya and France, concluded in Nairobi. Paris used the event to seek renewed engagement with the African continent following years of strained relations with former colonies.

stories.title: EU invites Taliban members to discuss Afghan migrant returns
stories.summary: The European Commission invited Taliban officials from Afghanistan to discuss the return of certain Afghan migrants. The move is controversial on humanitarian grounds and because the EU does not formally recognize the Taliban as Afghanistan's governing authority.

stories.title: EU invites Taiban members to discuss Afghan migrant returns
stories.summary: The European Commission invited Taliban officials from Afghanistan to discuss the return of certain migrants. The move is controversial on humanitarian grounds and because the EU does not officially recognize Taliban authority.

stories.title: Putin hails Russia’s test of new nuclear-capable ICBM, calls it world’s most powerful
stories.summary: Russia test-fired a new intercontinental ballistic missile called the Sarmat, which President Vladimir Putin described as the world's most powerful missile. Putin said the nuclear-capable ICBM would enter combat service by year's end, replacing the Soviet-era Voyevoda.

stories.title: Serbia hosts first joint military exercise with NATO
stories.summary: Serbia held its first joint military exercise with NATO, consisting of two weeks of drills. The cooperation is notable given that NATO conducted a bombing campaign against Belgrade less than 30 years ago during the Kosovo war.

stories.title: Microsoft Israel chief fired over use of Azure by Israeli army
stories.summary: Microsoft fired the head of its Israel operations following an investigation that revealed the company's Azure cloud services were used to store Israeli military surveillance data. Other senior figures at Microsoft Israel also lost their positions in connection with the matter.

stories.title: FBI questions CIA officers over Russia assessment in Brennan probe, sources say
stories.summary: The FBI has begun interviewing current and former CIA employees as part of a Department of Justice investigation into former CIA Director John Brennan. The probe concerns Brennan's role in the intelligence assessment that Russia interfered in the 2016 U.S. presidential election to help Donald Trump, according to five sources familiar with the matter.

stories.title: Iraq's PMF begins major desert sweep after 'Israel base' reports
stories.summary: Iraq's Popular Mobilisation Forces launched a large-scale security sweep in the desert areas of Najaf and Karbala provinces. The operation followed reports alleging the existence of a secret Israeli base in the region.

stories.title: Voters head to the polls in the Bahamas for high-stakes snap election
stories.summary: Voters in the Bahamas went to the polls in a snap election, with 41 parliamentary seats at stake. Key campaign issues included affordability, wage growth, and housing costs.

stories.title: Foreign Ministry Accuses West of Seeking Anti-Russian ‘Staging Ground’ in Central Asia
stories.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry accused Western nations of seeking to establish an anti-Russian "staging ground" in Central Asia. A senior diplomat warned that the U.S. and allies aim to control the region's strategic resources and transportation corridors.

stories.title: Trump posts late-night social media spree as Iran war drags on
stories.summary: President Donald Trump posted more than 50 times on social media over three hours late Monday into early Tuesday, attacking Barack Obama, the New York Times, and the Supreme Court. The posting spree came just hours before a trip to China for talks with President Xi Jinping.

stories.title: Starmer needs sharper survival strategy if he is to stay on
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces a growing leadership crisis as the number of Labour MPs calling for his resignation has increased. Much of his cabinet has remained quiet rather than offering public support, weakening his position compared to a previous leadership challenge.

stories.title: No sign of larger hantavirus outbreak, says UN health agency
stories.summary: The World Health Organization said there is currently no evidence of a larger hantavirus outbreak. However, WHO's head cautioned that the situation remains fluid and additional confirmed cases may emerge.

stories.title: Auschwitz survivor who returned to live in Germany dies aged 101
stories.summary: Albrecht Weinberg, a Holocaust survivor who was imprisoned at Auschwitz and Bergen-Belsen concentration camps, has died at age 101 in Leer, northwestern Germany. Weinberg spent years educating students about Nazi atrocities after returning to Germany in his 80s.

stories.title: Bomb rigged to rickshaw explodes in Pakistan bazaar, killing 9 and wounding more than 2 dozen others
stories.summary: A bomb rigged to a rickshaw exploded in a bazaar in Pakistan, killing nine people and wounding more than two dozen others. No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack.

stories.title: WATCH: Foreign national detainee vandalizes Israeli prison wall with swastika graffiti
stories.summary: A foreign national detained in an Israeli prison drew a swastika on a bathroom wall accessible from the exercise yard. Guards discovered the graffiti during a routine patrol of the facility.

stories.title: Israel sent Iron Dome anti-missile batteries and personnel to UAE: US envoy
stories.summary: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee confirmed that Israel deployed Iron Dome anti-missile batteries and personnel to the United Arab Emirates. Huckabee called on Gulf states to choose sides in the ongoing conflict between Israel and Iran, praising Abu Dhabi's cooperation.

stories.title: UAE’s secret attack on Iran risks drawing Gulf states into the war
stories.summary: Reports indicate the United Arab Emirates secretly launched a major attack on Iran during the ongoing conflict, raising the risk of Gulf states being drawn into direct war with Tehran. Separately, Kuwait said it captured at least four Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps members attempting attacks on Bubiyan Island.

stories.title: What Does SOUTHCOM’s New Autonomous Warfare Command Herald?
stories.summary: US Southern Command chief Gen. Frank Donovan discussed the creation of a new Autonomous Warfare Command aimed at deploying drones and autonomous systems across the Western Hemisphere. The command is intended to disrupt cartel networks designated as terrorist organizations and strengthen cooperation with regional allies.

stories.title: Court hearing on preventive measure for Yermak postponed as defense requests time to review case materials
stories.summary: A court hearing on a preventive measure for former Presidential Office head Andriy Yermak was postponed after his defense team said it had not had sufficient time to review the case materials.

stories.title: US faces rising costs with Iran war driving energy prices, inflation higher
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose sharply in April as the war with Iran drove energy costs higher. Petrol prices increased nearly 30 percent compared to the previous year, adding to domestic inflationary pressure.

stories.title: Iran chief negotiator says U.S. must accept proposal or face 'failure'
stories.summary: Iran's chief negotiator issued an ultimatum to the United States to accept Tehran's 14-point peace proposal or face diplomatic failure. The statement followed U.S. President Donald Trump's rejection of Iran's latest counteroffer in ongoing negotiations.

stories.title: Rational or reckless? War, Iran, and the limits of strategy - Sponsored Content
stories.summary: Israel Policy Forum Chief Policy Officer Michael Koplow joined Yehuda Kurtzer for a discussion assessing the current state of US-Iran-Israel relations. The conversation examined whether strategic decisions in the ongoing conflict are rational or reckless.

stories.title: Pakistan, China discuss Iran-US mediation and Strait of Hormuz stability
stories.summary: Pakistani Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar spoke with China's Wang Yi about Pakistan's mediation efforts between Iran and the United States. China expressed support for Pakistan's role, and both sides emphasized the importance of stability in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Investor jitters over Starmer uncertainty drive UK borrowing costs to 28-year high
stories.summary: UK 30-year government bond yields rose to 5.81%, the highest level since 1998, as investors reacted to uncertainty surrounding a potential Labour leadership change. The pound also fell against the dollar amid concerns about possible shifts in tax and spending policy.

stories.title: “Mirror response”: Ukraine confirms Orenburg strike 1,500 km from border after renewed Russian aerial attacks
stories.summary: Ukraine confirmed a drone strike on Orenburg, approximately 1,500 km from the Ukrainian border, which damaged a residential building near a major missile and aircraft components plant. The attack was described as a mirror response to renewed Russian aerial assaults on Ukrainian territory.

stories.title: Trump: '100% confident' Iran will stop enriching uranium, will hand over remaining stockpiles
stories.summary: President Trump said he is "100% confident" Iran will stop enriching uranium and hand over remaining stockpiles, stressing the U.S. will never allow Iran to possess a nuclear weapon.

stories.title: Police shoot man dead in Bedford after overnight standoff
stories.summary: Police in Bedford, England, shot and killed a man in his 40s after an overnight standoff. Officers responded to reports of vehicle damage and found the man barricaded inside a property making threats. Bedfordshire police said the man presented a weapon before officers fired.

stories.title: Hezbollah chief says his Iran-backed group's weapons not part of negotiations with Israel
stories.summary: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem declared that the group's weapons are strictly an internal Lebanese matter and are not subject to negotiations with Israel. He stated that no outside party has any role in decisions regarding the armed group's arsenal.

stories.title: Inside US Democrats’ Gaza fight – and what it means for 2028 elections
stories.summary: A deepening rift within the US Democratic Party over support for Israel and the Gaza conflict is raising questions about the party's direction ahead of the 2028 elections. Once considered politically untouchable, backing for Israel has become a divisive issue among Democrats.

stories.title: Russian forces intensify pressure on Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors, 57 attacks recorded since day starts
stories.summary: Russian forces launched 57 attacks on Ukrainian positions since the start of the day, with the heaviest pressure directed at the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors of the front line.

stories.title: War in Iran: Despite Iranian attacks, Doha steps up mediation efforts
stories.summary: Qatar is intensifying regional mediation efforts despite the Iran war bringing airstrikes and disrupting Doha's access to global oil markets. Doha is attempting to leverage its relationships with both the United States and Iran.

stories.title: US first lady not travelling to China with Trump
stories.summary: First Lady Melania Trump did not accompany President Donald Trump on his trip to China, according to her office. This contrasts with the 2017 state visit to Beijing, when she joined the president.

stories.title: Iran parliamentary spox. warns could enrich uranium if attacked
stories.summary: An Iranian parliamentary spokesperson warned that Iran could resume uranium enrichment if attacked. The nuclear issue remains a central point of contention in ongoing U.S.-Iran negotiations aimed at ending the conflict that began in late February.

stories.title: Ethiopian marathon runner Melese dies aged 36
stories.summary: Ethiopian long-distance runner Yebrgual Melese died at age 36 after falling ill during a routine training session.

stories.title: Why the U.S. Is Headed for a Long War With Iran
stories.summary: Analysis suggests the United States may face a prolonged military conflict with Iran, citing Tehran's increasingly hardline posture. Observers note the Iranian regime has little remaining incentive to de-escalate.

stories.title: Palestine Action activists to be sentenced as terrorists without jury’s knowledge
stories.summary: Six Palestine Action activists in the UK are set to be sentenced under terrorism-related provisions, a fact that was kept from the jury during trial due to reporting restrictions at Woolwich Crown Court.

stories.title: BBC Russia reports student recruited into Russia’s drone forces killed in Ukraine
stories.summary: BBC Russia confirmed the death of Valery Averin, a 23-year-old student from Buryatia who was killed in Ukraine after being recruited into Russia's unmanned systems forces. It is the first confirmed fatality linked to a large-scale military recruitment campaign at Russian universities.

stories.title: Russia, Ukraine end US-brokered truce with fresh attacks
stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine resumed hostilities after a U.S.-brokered ceasefire expired. The Russian military said it shot down 27 Ukrainian drones following the truce's end.

stories.title: Evolving drone war in southern Lebanon clouds Iran peace prospects
stories.summary: Hezbollah and Israel are escalating a drone war in southern Lebanon, complicating prospects for a broader Iran peace deal. The intensifying exchanges, captured on camera, come as Washington and Tehran remain at odds over ending attacks on shipping that are disrupting the global economy.

stories.title: Amid ceasefire, Iranian museum opens ‘Art & War’ exhibit, including US Jewish artist
stories.summary: Tehran's Museum of Contemporary Art opened an "Art & War" exhibit, its first since reopening, coinciding with a ceasefire period. The exhibition includes work by American Jewish artist Roy Lichtenstein among other pieces.

stories.title: Iran gambles that Trump will blink first in Hormuz standoff, but risks overplaying its hand
stories.summary: Analysts say Iran is calculating that President Trump will back down first in the ongoing Strait of Hormuz standoff, viewing the negotiations as existential. However, Tehran risks overplaying its hand as it faces both a discontented domestic population and a US president under midterm election pressure.

stories.title: SBU officer arrested for passing classified information to Russia
stories.summary: Ukrainian law enforcement arrested a major from a regional unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) on suspicion of passing classified information about Ukrainian operatives to Russia's FSB.

stories.title: Donald Trump 'very disappointed' with Kurdish opposition groups following US backing - analysis
stories.summary: President Trump expressed disappointment with Kurdish opposition groups following U.S. support, apparently referring to weapons transfers. He claimed only limited arms and ammunition had been sent.

stories.title: Meet the First Costa Ricans to Be Extradited on Drug Charges to the US
stories.summary: Several high-profile Costa Rican figures have been extradited to the United States on drug trafficking charges, marking the first such extraditions from the country. The accused allegedly participated in transnational cocaine trafficking networks with links to Colombia and Mexico.

stories.title: Despite improved macroeconomic stability in first half of FY26, war in Middle East poses significant risks to outlook: SBP
stories.summary: The State Bank of Pakistan released its half-year report for fiscal year 2026, noting improved macroeconomic stability despite global trade uncertainty and domestic floods. The report warned that the ongoing war in the Middle East poses significant risks to Pakistan's economic outlook.

stories.title: Tea at the Forbidden City: how SCMP covered 2017 Xi-Trump meeting
stories.summary: The South China Morning Post recalled its 2017 coverage of President Trump's first visit to China, when Xi Jinping hosted the Trumps for tea at Beijing's Forbidden City. The historic venue was chosen to symbolize cooperation between the two nations.

stories.title: The resistible integration of Arabs into the Israeli democratic game - opinion
stories.summary: An opinion piece discussed the political barriers to fuller integration of Arab citizens into Israeli democratic institutions, noting that the obstacles are more political than societal despite persistent racism.

stories.title: US Senate confirms Trump pick Kevin Warsh to Federal Reserve Board
stories.summary: The U.S. Senate confirmed Kevin Warsh as a Federal Reserve Board governor in a 51–45 largely party-line vote. Warsh is expected to take over as Fed chair later in the week, as the U.S. economy faces inflation at a three-year high.

stories.title: At least 100 killed in Nigerian airstrike on Zamfara market, says Amnesty
stories.summary: Amnesty International reported that at least 100 people were killed in a Nigerian military airstrike on a market in Zamfara state. No further details on the circumstances or military response were immediately provided.

stories.title: Hamas 'weaponised' sexual violence in 7 October attacks, Israeli investigation says
stories.summary: An Israeli investigation has concluded that Hamas systematically carried out sexual violence during the 7 October attacks. The report, described as the most comprehensive of its kind, documents numerous cases of sexual assault that it characterizes as deliberate and organized.

stories.title: Lebanon releases footage of Israel 'deliberately targeting' healthcare workers
stories.summary: Lebanese Health Minister Rakan Nasseredine released video footage showing what he described as repeated Israeli attacks on paramedics and healthcare workers across Lebanon, including an incident where a blast struck an ambulance during an evacuation.

stories.title: Hegseth rethinking Army reforms, cuts to aviation
stories.summary: US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth indicated he is reviewing the Army Transformation Initiative one year after its launch. He is reconsidering planned reforms and proposed cuts to Army aviation programs.

stories.title: Israeli report says Hamas used 'systematic, widespread' sexual violence in October 7 attack
stories.summary: An independent Israeli investigative commission released a report finding that Hamas used "systematic, widespread" sexual violence as a central component of its October 7, 2023, attack on Israel. The report also found sexual violence was used during the captivity of hostages taken to Gaza.

stories.title: Rash of teen violence renews focus on south Tel Aviv gang linked to migrants’ kids
stories.summary: A wave of teen violence in south Tel Aviv has drawn renewed attention to the SSQ gang, largely composed of children of migrants who lack legal status. Incidents include robberies and assaults, with some attributing the problem to systemic marginalization of the community.

stories.title: At least 100 killed in Nigerian airstrike on Zamfara market, Amnesty says
stories.summary: At least 100 civilians were killed in a Nigerian military airstrike on a crowded market in Zamfara state in northwest Nigeria, according to Amnesty International. The rights organization called on Nigerian authorities to open an immediate investigation into the incident.

stories.title: UK PM Starmer defies calls to quit, says he's getting on with governing
stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer rejected calls to resign on Tuesday, telling his cabinet he would continue governing despite growing pressure following Labour's poor performance in local elections. Four ministers publicly expressed support, and Starmer noted no official leadership contest had been triggered.

stories.title: Israel sent Iron Dome air defense systems to UAE, US envoy says
stories.summary: Israel has sent Iron Dome air defense system batteries along with operating personnel to the United Arab Emirates, according to U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee. The deployment was confirmed on Tuesday, May 12.

stories.title: Palestine Action defence barrister wins UK contempt of court challenge
stories.summary: Human rights barrister Rajiv Menon KC won an appeal against a contempt of court finding related to a closing speech he delivered at Woolwich Crown Court while defending Palestine Action activists accused of damaging weapons at an Israeli army-linked factory near Bristol.

stories.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina left vulnerable by policy clash with US, representative says
stories.summary: Christian Schmidt, the outgoing UN High Representative for Bosnia and Herzegovina, warned the UN Security Council that the multi-ethnic state could fall apart. He cited policy clashes with the United States and pressure from Russia, with complications involving commercial interests linked to Donald Trump Jr.

stories.title: Yermak ahead of court hearing: “I hope for fair and independent decision”
stories.summary: Former head of Ukraine's Office of the President Andriy Yermak stated ahead of a court hearing that he expects a fair, impartial, and independent decision in his case.

stories.title: South Africa's top court bars repeat asylum applications
stories.summary: South Africa's highest court ruled to bar repeat asylum applications. The home affairs minister described the decision as a victory against abuse of the country's refugee system.

stories.title: Kuwait says foiled infiltration attempt by four members of IRGC
stories.summary: Kuwait announced it foiled an infiltration attempt by four members of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. A Kuwaiti serviceman was wounded in an exchange of fire on an island, and two of the IRGC members escaped.

stories.title: Quarantine, stronger health coordination: WHO’s recommendations to limit the hantavirus crisis
stories.summary: The World Health Organization recommended quarantine measures, strengthened contact tracing, and enhanced surveillance of suspected cases to limit the spread of the hantavirus crisis.

stories.title: Israel’s war creating a ‘lost generation’ of Lebanese students
stories.summary: Israel's military operations in Lebanon have displaced hundreds of thousands of people, severely disrupting the country's education system. The conflict is compounding existing challenges and threatening to create a generation of Lebanese students unable to continue their schooling.

stories.title: Kuwait to 'explore new opportunities' around building strategic storage in Pakistan’s petroleum sector
stories.summary: Kuwait agreed to explore opportunities for building strategic petroleum storage in Pakistan during a meeting between Pakistan's Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik and Kuwait's Ambassador Nassar Abdulrahman Jasser Almutairi in Islamabad. Both sides discussed enhanced cooperation in refining and energy sectors.

stories.title: Australia unveils $45.2 billion defense budget with ramp up in AUKUS spending
stories.summary: Australia announced a $45.2 billion defense budget, representing a six percent increase over the previous year. The budget includes a significant ramp-up in spending related to the AUKUS security partnership with the United States and the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Russia plans chatbot platform for teenagers’ ‘moral and spiritual development,’ experts say it won’t work
stories.summary: Russia's Federal Agency for Youth Affairs, Rosmolodezh, has issued a tender to build a chatbot platform aimed at guiding teenagers through life situations and promoting their "moral and spiritual development." Experts cited in the report expressed skepticism about the initiative's viability.

stories.title: Second assailant arrested in connection to vicious assault at DePaul University
stories.summary: Kasem Noubani, 24, was arrested as a second suspect in connection with an assault at DePaul University in Chicago. He faces charges of aggravated battery and two counts of a hate crime, matching charges against a co-defendant who pleaded guilty in 2025.

stories.title: Kuwait says it foils infiltration operation by Iran’s IRGC
stories.summary: Kuwait announced it foiled an infiltration operation by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps on Bubiyan Island. Kuwaiti authorities arrested four men accused of being IRGC operatives who attempted the failed incursion.

stories.title: U.S. envoy says Israel sent Iron Dome battery, personnel to UAE
stories.summary: U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee confirmed that Israel deployed an Iron Dome battery and personnel to the United Arab Emirates. The move was described as a reflection of the deepening security relationship between Israel and the UAE under the Abraham Accords.

stories.title: Head of Microsoft’s Israel branch to step down after inquiry into dealings with Israeli military
stories.summary: The head of Microsoft's Israeli subsidiary will step down following an internal inquiry into the company's business dealings with the Israeli military. The investigation was prompted by reports that Israel used Microsoft technology for mass surveillance of Palestinian civilian phone calls.

stories.title: Israeli-Cypriot cyber company to unveil Starlink de-anonymizing tool - report
stories.summary: An Israeli-Cypriot cybersecurity company plans to unveil a tool called Stargetz that can de-anonymize Starlink satellite internet users. The tool is designed to work alongside the company's existing VPN de-anonymizing product, VPNz.

stories.title: Palestinian children shot, stabbed in W. Bank by Israelis: UN
