stories.summary: Experts discussed whether AI-generated Holocaust content, such as a World Jewish Congress clip featuring Anne Frank, helps preserve memory or risks distorting historical understanding. Concerns were raised about opportunistic exploitation of AI-generated material as firsthand survivor testimony diminishes.

stories.title: US issues alert to banks on IRGC efforts to evade sanctions
stories.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department issued an alert on Monday to financial institutions warning about the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' attempts to circumvent American sanctions, amid rising tensions in the ongoing conflict with Iran.

stories.title: Labs across three continents confirm passenger-to-passenger spread on hantavirus cruise
stories.summary: Laboratories in South Africa, Switzerland, and the Netherlands have confirmed through genomic analysis that hantavirus spread from passenger to passenger aboard the polar cruise ship MV Hondius. The outbreak infected ten people and killed three during the voyage.

stories.title: Americans don’t think Trump has explained Iran war goals, Reuters/Ipsos poll shows
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found that roughly one-third of Republicans and nearly all Democrats believe President Trump has not clearly articulated the objectives of U.S. military involvement in Iran.

stories.title: US to release 53 million barrels from strategic oil reserve
stories.summary: The Trump administration announced the release of 53.3 million barrels of crude oil from the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve to stabilize global markets disrupted by the Iran conflict. Nine energy companies, including Exxon Mobil, Trafigura, and Marathon Petroleum, are set to receive the supply amid Strait of Hormuz tensions.

stories.title: Israel condemns NYT article on sexual abuse of Palestinians in Israeli prisons
stories.summary: Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned a New York Times opinion piece by Nicholas Kristof on alleged sexual abuse of Palestinians in Israeli prisons, calling it a "blood libel." The ministry posted its response on X, disputing the article's portrayal of Israel.

stories.title: AI disinformation? Singapore accused in pro-China videos of being ‘ungrateful’
stories.summary: Chinese-language videos suspected of being AI-generated deepfakes have circulated on platforms like Douyin and WeChat, criticizing Singapore for allegedly mistreating China and aligning with the United States. Digital experts identified clues such as identical scripts across clips featuring different AI-generated narrators.

stories.title: Cannes 2026 rolls out red carpet amid AI spat, absence of major US studios
stories.summary: The 2026 Cannes Film Festival opened on Tuesday with 22 films competing for the Palme d'Or. Off-screen debate is dominated by a dispute over AI's impact on the film industry, with festival director Thierry Frémaux and thousands of French filmmakers voicing concerns. Major Hollywood studios including Disney and Warner are absent.

stories.title: Panda power: Pakistan to tap China debt market with first sale of yuan-priced notes
stories.summary: Pakistan plans to raise up to $250 million through its first-ever sale of panda bonds—yuan-denominated debt instruments sold in China's onshore market. Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb confirmed preparations to access Chinese capital markets as part of Belt and Road Initiative financial cooperation.

stories.title: Syria restores credit card payments in effort to rejoin the global economy
stories.summary: Syria has restored credit card payment services as part of broader efforts to reintegrate into the global financial system. The move marks a step toward normalizing the country's economic infrastructure.

stories.title: CBS: Pakistan hosted Iranian military planes at Nur Khan air base in Rawalpindi
stories.summary: CBS News reported that Pakistan allowed Iranian military aircraft to be stationed at Nur Khan Air Base near Rawalpindi during the US-Iran conflict, despite Islamabad's role as a diplomatic intermediary. The aircraft were reportedly moved shortly after President Trump announced a ceasefire in early April.

stories.title: UK man convicted after assaulting people on the street while asking if they were Jewish
stories.summary: Dylan Ossei, 34, was convicted in a UK court of religiously aggravated assault, fear of violence, and harassment after attacking people on the street while asking if they were Jewish.

stories.title: US imposes new sanctions tied to Iranian oil sales to China
stories.summary: The Trump administration imposed new sanctions targeting 12 individuals and entities accused of helping Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps sell and transport oil to China. The US Treasury said the IRGC used front companies in permissive jurisdictions to conceal oil sales and channel revenue to Tehran.

stories.title: Family of Florida mass shooting victim sues OpenAI in US court
stories.summary: The family of a victim killed in the 2025 mass shooting at Florida State University filed a lawsuit against OpenAI. The family alleges that ChatGPT helped the shooter plan the attack.

stories.title: UAE targeted Iran's Lavan Island refinery during secret attacks against Islamic regime - report
stories.summary: A report indicates the UAE secretly struck Iran's Lavan Island oil refinery during the recent conflict, prior to the current ceasefire. The Emirati government has not publicly confirmed its participation in the strikes against Iran.

stories.title: Roads blocked in Bolivia as protesters demand president’s resignation
stories.summary: Protesters in Bolivia have blocked roads across major cities, disrupting travel and demanding the resignation of the president. The widespread blockades reflect growing unrest in the country.

stories.title: Iraqi military denies reports of secret foreign bases in Karbala desert
stories.summary: Iraq's Armed Forces denied reports of unauthorized foreign military installations in the deserts near Karbala and Najaf. The military attributed the rumors to a March 5 clash between Iraqi security forces and unidentified, unlicensed armed groups that reportedly received air cover.

stories.title: UK spends over £16.5M on Starlink, including for Ukraine
stories.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence has spent over £16.5 million on Starlink terminals and satellite internet services, including to support operations in Ukraine. The expenditure covers both domestic military use and assistance to Ukrainian forces.

stories.title: Amnesty says Palestinian healthcare workers punished for saving lives
stories.summary: Amnesty International official Erika Guevara Rosas called for the immediate release of Palestinian doctor Hussam Abu Safiya, describing his imprisonment as 500 days of arbitrary detention. Rosas urged Israel to free all detained Palestinian healthcare workers, saying they were being punished for saving lives.

stories.title: Mayor of California city resigns over charges of being a foreign agent of China
stories.summary: Eileen Wang, 58, the mayor of Arcadia, California, resigned on Monday after the US Department of Justice charged her with acting as an illegal foreign agent of China. Wang agreed to plead guilty to the felony count and faces up to ten years in prison.

stories.title: Trump says he will discuss arms sales to Taiwan with China’s Xi
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump stated he would discuss arms sales to Taiwan with Chinese President Xi Jinping at their upcoming summit. The remark came in response to questions about Washington's longstanding support for Taiwan's defense.

stories.title: Iran rejects US-backed UN resolution on Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi criticized a US-backed draft UN Security Council resolution on the Strait of Hormuz. Writing on X, he accused Washington of attempting to reframe the consequences of military aggression and an illegal siege as a case against Iran.

stories.title: 10 injured in truck-bus crash outside Hong Kong shopping centre
stories.summary: Ten people were injured in a collision between a truck and a KMB double-decker bus outside Po Tat Shopping Centre in Hong Kong's Kwun Tong district. Police reported the crash occurred on Po Lam Road in Sau Mau Ping at approximately 6:20 a.m. Tuesday, with all injuries described as mild.

stories.title: Yandex subsidiary fined for transferring Yango taxi users’ personal data to Russia
stories.summary: Finland's Data Protection Ombudsman fined MLU B.V., a Dutch-registered subsidiary of Russian technology company Yandex, 100 million euros. The penalty was imposed for illegally transferring personal data of Yango taxi service users to Russia.

stories.title: Acclaimed biologist Xu Xianzhong returns to China after arrests in his US lab
stories.summary: Biologist Xu Xianzhong, a fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science, has returned to China and joined the Shenzhen Medical Academy of Research and Translation. His departure from the University of Michigan follows the arrest of four researchers in his lab on charges of biological material smuggling in the United States.

stories.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump criticized Iran's latest counteroffer to end hostilities, calling the month-long ceasefire "unbelievably weak" and describing it as being on "massive life support." The remarks signal growing uncertainty over diplomatic efforts between Washington and Tehran.

stories.title: UK’s Starmer under pressure to quit as ministers reportedly ask him to step down
stories.summary: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces mounting pressure to resign following Labour's poor performance in local elections. Four ministerial aides have quit and over 70 Labour lawmakers have publicly called for his departure, though Starmer has vowed to remain in his role.

stories.title: The Rise of the 'Yen-style' Advantage: Why US Digital Nomads are Flocking to the Southern Cone
stories.summary: The article explores why increasing numbers of US digital nomads are relocating to South America's Southern Cone, drawn by favorable exchange rates and lower living costs compared to expensive US housing markets.

stories.title: Ousmane Dembélé named player of the year in France for second straight year
stories.summary: Paris Saint-Germain forward Ousmane Dembélé was named France's player of the year for the second consecutive season. He became only the fifth player to win the award in back-to-back years, despite experiencing a difficult campaign.

stories.title: Russia's shadow fleet ships defying PM's threat and entering UK waters
stories.summary: BBC Verify analysis of ship-tracking data revealed that Russian "shadow fleet" vessels continued sailing into UK waters despite government threats to board them. The finding undermines the UK's stated policy of deterring sanctioned Russian oil tankers.

stories.title: Soldier dies during parachute training incident at Jervis Bay – the second such death in two years
stories.summary: An Australian army soldier died during a parachute training exercise at Jervis Bay airfield on Monday evening. The Australian Defence Department confirmed another soldier was injured but did not require hospitalization. It is the second parachute training death at the site in two years.

stories.title: Zelenskiy holds call with UAE counterpart
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy spoke by phone with UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The leaders discussed UAE assistance in securing the return of Ukrainians held in Russian captivity and the ongoing war involving Iran.

stories.title: NYT’s Eurovision ‘investigation’ into Israel misses the point - analysis
stories.summary: The New York Times published an investigation framing Israel's Eurovision campaigning as suspicious soft-power activity. The report acknowledged no rules were broken and that other participating countries engaged in similar promotional efforts.

stories.title: Russia-Ukraine ceasefire expires after 3 days, with both sides accusing each other of violations
stories.summary: A three-day ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, proposed by U.S. President Donald Trump and accepted by both sides, expired at midnight on May 12. Both Moscow and Kyiv accused each other of violating the truce during its brief duration.

stories.title: UAE secretly struck Iran during war, including attack on oil refinery — report
stories.summary: A report indicates the UAE secretly carried out military strikes against Iran during the recent conflict, including an attack on an oil refinery on Iran's Lavan Island. The United States reportedly welcomed Abu Dhabi's involvement after other Gulf states refused to participate in the war effort.

stories.title: Pressure grows on UK's Starmer to quit as PM
stories.summary: Several UK cabinet ministers have called on Prime Minister Keir Starmer to announce plans to resign following Labour's poor results in local elections. Pressure on Starmer's leadership has intensified within his own party.

stories.title: EU to invite Taliban to Brussels for migrant return talks
stories.summary: The European Commission plans to invite Taliban officials to Brussels for talks on returning migrants to Afghanistan. The discussions would focus on arrangements for migrant repatriation.

stories.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire on ‘massive life support’ after rejecting Tehran’s response
stories.summary: President Trump rejected Iran's response to his ceasefire proposal, calling it a "piece of garbage" and saying he did not finish reading it. Trump characterized the Iran ceasefire as being on "massive life support."

stories.title: ‘Difficult’ mission to repatriate Australian hantavirus cruise passengers en route to long Perth quarantine
stories.summary: Australians and New Zealanders aboard the hantavirus-affected cruise ship MC Hondius were transported to the Netherlands before being repatriated. Australian Health Minister Mark Butler said six passengers and charter flight crew will undergo 42 days of quarantine at the Bullsbrook national resilience centre near Perth.

stories.title: Shepherd sacrifices life, averting suicide attack in Attock
stories.summary: A shepherd named Liaqat sacrificed his life to prevent a suicide attack on the Mankor security post in Attock's Jand area near the Punjab-Khyber Pakhtunkhwa border in Pakistan. District Police Officer Sardar Marwan Khan confirmed the incident potentially saved dozens of lives.

stories.title: Haiti too insecure for August presidential vote, PM says
stories.summary: Haiti's Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé stated that the country's security conditions are insufficient to hold elections in August. Haiti has not held a presidential vote in a decade.

stories.title: Japan’s new spy agency receives FBI backing with eyes on China and Russia
stories.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is advancing legislation to create a centralized intelligence agency, the first since World War II, by expanding the Cabinet Intelligence and Research Office. The initiative, endorsed by the US FBI, aims to address fragmented intelligence capabilities against espionage, cyberthreats, and grey-zone operations linked to China and Russia.

stories.title: Iran war live: Trump slams Iranian proposal as ceasefire hangs by a thread
stories.summary: Iran's parliamentary speaker stated that the United States has no alternative but to accept Tehran's 14-point proposal to end the ongoing conflict. The remarks come as ceasefire negotiations between the two countries remain uncertain.

stories.title: California mayor resigns, will plead guilty to acting as a China agent
stories.summary: Eileen Wang, the mayor of Arcadia, California, resigned and agreed to plead guilty to acting as an illegal agent of the Chinese government. She was charged in April with conducting activities on behalf of Chinese officials, including sharing pro-Beijing articles, without notifying the U.S. government as required by law.

stories.title: Zelensky says return of Ukrainian children must remain key issue in politics and media
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky urged that the return of Ukrainian children abducted by Russia must remain a priority in both political and media agendas.

stories.title: U.S.-Iran ceasefire on ‘life support’, says Trump
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump described Iran's ceasefire proposal as a "piece of garbage," declaring negotiations to be on "life support" and refusing to engage further with Tehran's terms.

stories.title: Tens of millions risk hunger as Hormuz stand-off blocks fertiliser, UN official says
stories.summary: A UN official warned that the military standoff near the Strait of Hormuz is disrupting fertiliser shipments, putting tens of millions of people at risk of hunger. Approximately one-third of the world's fertiliser supply normally passes through the strait.

stories.title: India's Modi to launch multi-nation tour amid global unrest
stories.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi will begin a multi-nation tour starting with the UAE on Friday, where he will meet Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan to discuss energy cooperation amid Middle East supply disruptions. The tour will also include visits to four European countries.

stories.title: UAE secretly joined Israeli-US strikes on Iran: Report
stories.summary: According to a report, the United Arab Emirates secretly participated in Israeli-U.S. military strikes against Iran, including an attack on an oil refinery on Lavan Island in early April. The revelation points to a deeper UAE-Israel strategic alignment in the conflict with Tehran.

stories.title: Elon Musk, Apple’s Tim Cook and Boeing CEO going to China with Trump, official says
stories.summary: Elon Musk, Apple CEO Tim Cook, and Boeing's CEO are accompanying President Trump on a trip to China. Boeing's CEO expressed hope the Trump administration would help secure a long-awaited major aircraft order from China.

stories.title: Zelensky holds meeting on countering Russian aerial bombs
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky convened a meeting of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief's Staff to discuss measures for countering Russian aerial bomb attacks on Ukrainian territory.

stories.title: Eurovision's other Israel-related challenge: new voting rules
stories.summary: The 2025 Eurovision Song Contest in Vienna faces challenges related to Israeli participation, including boycotts from some countries. New public-voting rules have been introduced to address concerns about vote mobilization that arose during the previous competition.

stories.title: Divisive bill barring non-Orthodox practices at Western Wall back on Knesset agenda
stories.summary: A bill that would grant Israel's chief rabbis ultimate authority over the Western Wall and bar non-Orthodox religious practices there has returned to the Knesset agenda. The legislation could classify non-Orthodox worship as desecration, carrying a penalty of up to seven years in prison.

stories.title: How the Trump-Xi summit could set superpower relations for many years to come
stories.summary: President Trump's visit to China for a summit with President Xi Jinping is being described as the most significant US-China engagement in years. Analysts are watching whether the meeting will produce lasting results for superpower relations.

stories.title: Knesset passes law to prosecute October 7 terrorists, conduct public trials in Jerusalem
stories.summary: The Israeli Knesset unanimously passed a law, 93 to 0, enabling prosecution and public trials in Jerusalem for those accused of carrying out the October 7 attacks. The vote took place as the Knesset opened its summer session on Sunday.

stories.title: Pressure mounts on British PM Starmer to quit after crushing Labour election losses
stories.summary: Dozens of Labour MPs reportedly urged British Prime Minister Keir Starmer to resign following heavy local and regional election losses. Starmer vowed to remain in office and prove doubters wrong, pledging to push a more ambitious policy agenda despite mounting pressure within his party.

stories.title: Pistorius visits Ukrainian air defense positions
stories.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius visited Ukrainian air defense positions, underscoring Berlin's continued support for Ukraine's military efforts.

stories.title: Couple jailed in Spain for locking children at home over Covid-19 fears
stories.summary: A couple in Spain was sentenced to prison for keeping their three children locked inside their home for three and a half years. The parents developed an extreme fear of the outside world following the COVID-19 pandemic.

stories.title: Bolivia's Evo Morales held in contempt after missing court in trafficking trial
stories.summary: A Bolivian judge held former President Evo Morales in contempt of court after he failed to appear for his trial on charges of trafficking a minor. The case is being closely watched in Bolivia.

stories.title: The big questions hanging over the Trump-Xi meeting in China
stories.summary: A planned summit between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Beijing was postponed after Trump approved joint strikes with Israel against Iran. The agenda includes Taiwan, tariffs, and the Strait of Hormuz, with questions about whether Trump may seek China's help to end the Iran conflict.

stories.title: UK households cut back spending at fastest rate in 18 months, Barclays says
stories.summary: UK household spending fell in April at the fastest rate in 18 months, according to Barclays credit and debit card data. The bank reported a 0.1% year-on-year decline in card spending, the first such drop since November 2024, as consumers grew cautious amid the Iran war's economic fallout.

stories.title: Birmingham City University urged not to axe Black studies MA
stories.summary: More than 100 academics, writers, and activists signed an open letter urging Birmingham City University not to close its MA in Black Studies and Global Justice, launched only months earlier. The move follows BCU's closure of its undergraduate Black studies course in 2024, raising concerns about the erasure of the discipline from UK higher education.

stories.title: US trial hears witness claims of harassment over Chinese ‘secret police station’
stories.summary: A US government witness testified in a New York federal trial that he was harassed after protesting an alleged Chinese secret police station directed from Fuzhou. Defendant Lu Jianwang, 64, faces charges of acting as an unauthorized agent of China, conspiracy, and obstruction of justice.

stories.title: Knesset advances controversial West Bank antiquity bill in first reading
stories.summary: The Israeli Knesset advanced a bill in its first reading concerning the management of antiquities in the occupied West Bank. Critics argue the legislation amounts to de facto annexation, while supporters say it is necessary to preserve the territory's cultural heritage.

stories.title: Ceasefire on 'life support', Trump says, as he rejects 'stupid' Iranian peace offer
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal, calling it "stupid" and "garbage," and said the existing ceasefire with Iran is on "life support." However, Trump stated that a deal remains possible despite repeated setbacks in negotiations.

stories.title: Trump rejects Iran's counteroffer to end war, insists on 'complete victory'
stories.summary: President Donald Trump rejected Iran's ceasefire counteroffer, which included demands for the release of frozen assets and an end to the US blockade, calling it unacceptable. The rejection sent oil prices soaring and dimmed hopes for reopening the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping.

stories.title: Russian drone hits roof of apartment building in Kharkiv
stories.summary: A Russian drone struck the roof of a multi-story residential building in the Shevchenkivskyi district of Kharkiv, Ukraine.

stories.title: UAE secretly carried out strikes on Iran, including on oil refinery — report
stories.summary: A report states that the UAE secretly carried out military strikes on Iran, including an attack on an oil refinery on Lavan Island in early April. Abu Dhabi has not publicly acknowledged involvement in the strikes.

stories.title: Knesset passes law establishing military tribunal to try October 7 perpetrators
stories.summary: Israel's Knesset unanimously passed legislation, 93-0, establishing a special military tribunal to try captured perpetrators of the October 7 Hamas-led attack. The proceedings will be filmed and broadcast publicly.

stories.title: Turkey-Syria border gate to reopen after 12-year closure
Russian drones strike industrial facility in Sumy region
stories.summary: Russian drones attacked an industrial facility in the Vorozhba community of Ukraine's Sumy region during an evening strike.

stories.title: Ceasefire on 'life support', Trump says, as he rejects 'stupid' Iranian peace offer
stories.summary: President Trump declared the ceasefire with Iran was on "life support" after rejecting Tehran's latest peace proposal. The remarks coincided with the US Treasury imposing a new round of sanctions to increase pressure on Iran.

stories.title: Qatar, Kuwait urge diplomacy to sustain US-Iran ceasefire
stories.summary: Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman al-Thani and Kuwait's Foreign Minister Sheikh Jarrah Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah called for continued diplomatic efforts to prevent a renewed escalation between the United States and Iran and to sustain the existing ceasefire.

stories.title: California gubernatorial candidate Steve Hilton mocked for misidentifying a ‘street taco’
stories.summary: California gubernatorial candidate Steve Hilton, a British political strategist, faced widespread mockery after posting a video misidentifying a hard-shell taco from the Del Taco fast food chain as a "street taco." The incident drew criticism in a state where tacos hold significant cultural importance.

stories.title: US, partner nations sink two decommissioned ships during Exercise Balikatan
stories.summary: During Exercise Balikatan, U.S., Philippine, Japanese, and Canadian forces conducted a two-day strike exercise that sank two decommissioned ships using coordinated land, sea, and air platforms.

stories.title: I led hikers up an Indonesian volcano - and then it erupted
stories.summary: A guide who led hikers up Mount Dukono in Indonesia described the moment the volcano erupted on Friday, killing three people. The eruption caught the hiking group on the mountain.

stories.title: Five ways of looking at the Japanese sinking of a decommissioned Philippine ship
stories.summary: During the Balikatan military exercises in the Philippines, the Japanese navy sank a decommissioned Philippine vessel. The exercise featured several missile-firing milestones involving participating forces.

stories.title: Three more countries join International Coalition for Return of Ukrainian Children – Sybiha
stories.summary: Panama, Switzerland, and Cyprus joined the International Coalition for the Return of Ukrainian Children, bringing total membership to 46 countries and three international organizations, according to Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha.

stories.title: Ukrainian children held in Russia: militarized, 'reeducated'
stories.summary: A Ukrainian repatriation initiative reports that at least 20,000 Ukrainian children are being held by Russian families and authorities. The children have reportedly been subjected to militarization and political re-education since their abduction.

stories.title: Senators decry hike in petroleum prices, accuse govt of 'economic oppression'
stories.summary: Pakistani senators criticized the government's latest increase in petroleum prices, calling it "economic oppression." PTI's Senate parliamentary leader Barrister Ali Zafar rejected claims that international oil prices necessitated the hike and called for Pakistan to exit its IMF programme.

stories.title: Narenda Modi tells Indians to stop buying gold, work from home, as Iran war dents economy
stories.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to stop purchasing gold and to work from home as the war involving Iran drives up energy prices. The appeal reflects growing pressure on India's foreign exchange reserves due to higher fuel costs.

stories.title: Docaviv 2026 reveals the Israeli film lineup
stories.summary: The Docaviv 2026 film festival announced twelve Israeli films selected for competition. Among those chosen are Soccer for the Soul by Avida Livny and Shalom by Meital Zvieli.

stories.title: ‘A consistent pattern of lying’: Musk v OpenAI trial exposes what insiders think of Sam Altman
stories.summary: The ongoing Musk v. OpenAI trial has revealed internal disputes and allegations about CEO Sam Altman's conduct during OpenAI's rise. Witnesses from across Silicon Valley have testified about the company's fractious corporate history, exposing details normally kept secret by the AI firm.

stories.title: China’s AI ascent leaves Trump a stark choice: escalate or relax chip controls?
stories.summary: As President Trump prepares for a landmark visit to China, U.S. policymakers face a decision on whether to tighten or loosen semiconductor export controls in response to China's rapid advances in artificial intelligence. The ongoing U.S.-Iran war is adding economic strain to Washington-Beijing relations.

stories.title: Sarah Wynn-Williams and Virginia Giuffre jointly win freedom to publish prize at British book awards
stories.summary: Meta whistleblower Sarah Wynn-Williams and the late Virginia Giuffre jointly won the Freedom to Publish prize at the British book awards. Wynn-Williams, author of a memoir about her time at Facebook, warned of powerful elites using wealth to silence dissent.

stories.title: Lamine Yamal waves Palestinian flag during Barcelona title parade
stories.summary: Spanish footballer Lamine Yamal waved a Palestinian flag during FC Barcelona's La Liga title celebration parade in the city. Footage showed him holding the flag atop an open-top bus as tens of thousands of supporters gathered. Spain has been among Europe's most vocal critics of Israel's war on Gaza.

stories.title: UK sanctions Iran-linked network, cites attack plots and finance operations
stories.summary: LONDON, May 11 - Britain on Monday sanctioned 12 individuals and entities linked to Iran, accusing them of involvement in hostile activity including plotting attacks and providing financial services t

stories.title: US Treasury Department tells banks to flag suspected Iranian money-laundering networks
stories.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department issued guidance to banks and financial institutions to monitor for suspected Iranian money-laundering networks. The networks allegedly use shell companies and cryptocurrency to smuggle sanctioned oil, as U.S.-Iran ceasefire negotiations remain stalled.

stories.title: Two years on, over a third of General Elections 2024 petitions await disposal
stories.summary: More than two years after Pakistan's February 2024 general elections, election tribunals have yet to resolve nearly a third of 374 filed petitions. According to the Free and Fair Election Network (Fafen), 128 cases remain pending, leaving dozens of lawmakers in office under legal uncertainty.

stories.title: Ukraine’s envoy laments Israel’s lack of ‘interest’ in Kyiv drone expertise
stories.summary: Ukraine's ambassador to Israel, Yevgen Korniychuk, expressed disappointment at Israel's lack of interest in acquiring Ukrainian drone expertise. He noted frustration that Israel is missing an opportunity to leverage Kyiv's battlefield experience to protect its own soldiers.

stories.title: EU ministers agree on sanctions targeting violent West Bank settlers
stories.summary: The sanctions package targets three settlers and four settler organisations.

stories.title: Lebanon urges US to put pressure on Israel to stop attacks and demolitions
stories.summary: BEIRUT, May 11 - Lebanon's president has urged the United States to put pressure on Israel to cease fire and stop home demolitions in south Lebanon, the presidency said on Monday, as the death toll fr

stories.title: Is Russia the Main Beneficiary of Trump’s Iran Mistake?
stories.summary: An analysis argues that Russia has become a major beneficiary of the U.S.-Iran conflict, as disrupted global energy markets have generated billions of dollars in additional oil revenue for the Kremlin.

stories.title: Trump heads to China with Musk, Cook and top CEOs for Xi talks
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is traveling to China this week accompanied by major business leaders including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Apple CEO Tim Cook, and BlackRock CEO Larry Fink. The delegation spans aviation, technology, banking, and other key industries for talks with Chinese leader Xi Jinping.

stories.title: Iran speaker warns US must accept Tehran' rights or face ‘failure after failure’
stories.summary: Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned the United States that it must recognize the rights of the Iranian people as outlined in Tehran's 14-point proposal. Writing on X, he said any alternative approach would lead to repeated failures.

stories.title: NABU names Yermak suspect in UAH 460M money laundering case
stories.summary: Ukraine's National Anti-Corruption Bureau formally named former Presidential Office head Andriy Yermak as a suspect in a case involving the alleged laundering of 460 million hryvnias linked to luxury construction near Kyiv.

stories.title: Ukraine names Zelensky’s former chief of staff, Andriy Yermak, as a suspect in a major money laundering case
stories.summary: Ukraine's NABU and SAPO launched investigative actions against Andriy Yermak, former chief of staff to President Zelensky, in a major money laundering case, as reported by Ukrainska Pravda and RBC-Ukraine.

stories.title: US imposes new sanctions over Iran oil sales to China
stories.summary: The United States on Monday imposed sanctions on 12 individuals and entities it accused of facilitating sales and shipments of Iranian oil to China.

stories.title: Syria says two soldiers killed in attack in northeast
stories.summary: Syria reported that two soldiers were killed in an attack by unidentified assailants in the country's northeast on Monday. No group has claimed responsibility for the incident.

stories.title: Hackers used AI to build zero-day attack, say Google researchers
stories.summary: Google said it has “high confidence” that AI was used to help discover and weaponise the exploit.

stories.title: NYT report finds Israel spent over $1mn on Eurovision campaign
stories.summary: A New York Times investigation found that Israel spent more than $1 million on a state-backed campaign to influence voting at the Eurovision Song Contest.

stories.title: Trump's Iran war goals unclear, Americans believe, Reuters/Ipsos poll shows
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted over four days showed widespread American concern about rising gasoline prices amid the Iran war. The survey also suggested many voters blame Trump's Republican allies for their economic difficulties.

stories.title: Brics doesn’t need a unified voice on Iran war to have a future
stories.summary: A report examines tensions within the BRICS grouping as two of its members, Iran and the UAE, find themselves on opposing sides of the Middle East conflict. Analysts argue the bloc can still function despite lacking a unified position on the war.

stories.title: Upcoming symposium aimed at tackling anti-Zionism shows movement gaining steam
stories.summary: A symposium scheduled in Toronto aims to confront anti-Zionism, framing it as a contemporary form of antisemitism. Organizers describe the gathering as the first of its kind, signaling a growing movement to formally label anti-Zionism as hatred.

stories.title: Trump to raise Taiwan, Jimmy Lai case when he meets Xi in Beijing this week
stories.summary: President Trump said he will raise Taiwan and the case of jailed Hong Kong media figure Jimmy Lai in his summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Beijing this week. Trump predicted Xi would be more likely to bring up the Taiwan issue during the talks.

stories.title: Twenty countries working with Ukraine on drone deals – Zelensky
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky announced that 20 countries are currently cooperating with Ukraine on drone production deals, highlighting the country's growing defense-industry partnerships.

stories.title: Watch: Avoid gold, foreign trips & adopt WFH: How will it affect the economy? | Above the Fold | 11.05.2026
stories.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to avoid gold purchases and foreign travel and to adopt work-from-home practices amid the West Asia crisis. The episode also covered political developments in Kerala and Tamil Nadu.

stories.title: SOCOM to test SkyFi satellite imagery-to-tablet prototype
stories.summary: U.S. Special Operations Command plans to test SkyFi's Sovereign Intelligence Platform, which enables field commanders to task commercial satellites and receive near-real-time imagery directly on tablets.

stories.title: Hundreds displaced, medical services suspended amid gang violence in Haiti
stories.summary: Doctors Without Borders suspended hospital operations in Haiti due to gunfire and escalating gang violence, leaving hundreds of people displaced and cutting off access to medical services.

stories.title: EU Takes Aim at Russia’s Abductions of Ukrainian Children
stories.summary: The European Union imposed sanctions targeting Russian officials involved in the abduction of Ukrainian children. An estimated 20,500 minors have been taken from Ukraine since Russia's full-scale invasion began in February 2022.

stories.title: Navalnaya calls former Anti-Corruption Foundation director’s interview a ‘lie,’ says she removed him for weak management
stories.summary: Yulia Navalnaya publicly responded to a former Anti-Corruption Foundation director's interview, calling it a lie and stating she removed Ivan Zhdanov from his position due to weak management after difficult negotiations.

stories.title: US nuclear submarine docks in Gibraltar
stories.summary: A U.S. nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine has docked at Gibraltar, the U.S. Navy confirmed. The visit was described as a demonstration of military reach and support for NATO allies amid rising tensions with Iran.

stories.title: Hungary's race to access EU's 10.4 billion euros is ambitious but possible - officials
stories.summary: BRUSSELS, May 11 - Hungary is racing to meet an August 31 deadline to become eligible for 10.4 billion euros  ($12.2 billion) from the European Union's post-pandemic recovery fund and while the task i

stories.title: Americans don't think Trump has explained Iran war goals: poll
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found that two out of three Americans believe President Donald Trump has not clearly explained the goals of the U.S. war with Iran.

stories.title: EU, UK sanction Russians over deportations of Ukrainian children
stories.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom imposed sanctions on Russian officials and institutions accused of systematically deporting and indoctrinating Ukrainian children during Russia's ongoing war against Ukraine.

stories.title: Sybiha: Russia’s proposal to put Ukrainian children on exchange lists “unacceptable”
stories.summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha called Russia's proposal to include deported Ukrainian children on prisoner exchange lists "unacceptable," insisting that the children's return must be a fundamental element of any peace process.

stories.title: Federal budget 2026 live updates: treasurer Jim Chalmers to present budget speech tonight – latest news
stories.summary: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers is set to deliver the 2026 federal budget speech. Meanwhile, Deputy Liberal leader Jane Hume declined to rule out a possible alliance with One Nation ahead of the next election.

stories.title: Trump to suspend US gas tax as Iran war spikes prices
stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced plans to suspend the federal gasoline tax as consumers face surging energy prices linked to the war with Iran.

stories.title: On this day: Adolf Eichmann captured in Argentina by Mossad
stories.summary: On this day in 1960, Mossad agents captured Adolf Eichmann, a key architect of the Holocaust, in Argentina. Eichmann was later tried in Israel and executed on June 1, 1962, the only person executed by the Israeli state.

stories.title: Israel blocks antisemitic YouTuber Tyler Oliveira from entering country
stories.summary: Israel denied entry to American YouTuber Tyler Oliveira, citing antisemitic content. Diaspora Affairs Minister stated that anyone arriving with the goal of sowing hatred would be turned away.

stories.title: Netanyahu condemns EU sanctions on settlers 'for living' in occupied West Bank
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office condemned the European Union's new sanctions on Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank. The statement rejected the measures as illegitimate, saying Israel would protect the rights of Jews to live in the territory.

stories.title: Iran warns European countries against sending warships to Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei warned European countries against sending warships to the Strait of Hormuz. He argued that European naval involvement would raise energy prices and further complicate an already tense situation.

stories.title: Report: Russia has spent billions building military-patriotic centers to train schoolchildren
stories.summary: An investigation by Vot Tak, a Russian-language outlet run by Polish public broadcaster TVP, found that Russian authorities have spent over 50 billion rubles in the past five years building military-patriotic centers. Schoolchildren undergo mandatory military training at these facilities.

stories.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1538:  Berlin plugs into Ukraine’s defense industry with “Brave Germany” initiative
stories.summary: Germany launched the "Brave Germany" initiative to integrate with Ukraine's defense industry on day 1,538 of the Russo-Ukrainian war. Berlin is currently the world's largest single provider of security assistance to Ukraine, supplying roughly one third of all aid.

stories.title: Skipper Shanto extends Bangladesh lead by 179 runs in first Test against Pakistan
stories.summary: Bangladesh captain Najmul Hossain Shanto scored an unbeaten 58 as Bangladesh reached 152-3 in their second innings on day four of the first Test against Pakistan in Dhaka. Bangladesh extended their lead to 179 runs at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium before rain interrupted play.

stories.title: Budanov: Ukraine ready for Zelensky-Putin talks if Kremlin is serious
stories.summary: Kyrylo Budanov, head of the Office of the President of Ukraine, said during a visit to Lithuania that Kyiv is prepared for talks between President Zelensky and Russian President Putin. He stipulated that the Kremlin must demonstrate genuine willingness to negotiate.

stories.title: Houthis still using Iranian components in missiles, expanding arsenal
stories.summary: The Houthi movement in Yemen continues to use Iranian-manufactured components in its missiles, expanding an arsenal that now includes anti-ship, surface-to-air, and ballistic missiles with advanced offensive capabilities.

stories.title: EU sanctions violent Israeli settlers after months of deadlock
stories.summary: The European Union has imposed sanctions on violent Israeli settlers and settler organisations in the occupied West Bank, freezing their assets. The package ends months of internal EU deadlock on the issue.

stories.title: Israel PM slams ‘moral bankruptcy’ of EU over settler sanctions
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu criticized the European Union for what he called "moral bankruptcy" after the bloc moved to sanction Israeli settlers. Far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir also condemned the EU decision, calling it antisemitic.

stories.title: Over 70 Labour MPs call for Starmer's resignation after election rout
stories.summary: More than 70 Labour Party MPs have publicly called for British Prime Minister Keir Starmer to resign following the party's heavy losses in local and regional elections held the previous Thursday. Several government resignations accompanied the growing pressure.

stories.title: Despite Trump statements, US president vetoed Kurdish uprising, sources confirm to 'Post'
stories.summary: Despite public statements blaming the Kurds, sources confirmed to the Jerusalem Post that US President Donald Trump vetoed a proposal to facilitate a Kurdish-led uprising against Iran.

stories.title: Trump’s China visit watched in US for signs of stability – and tangible wins
stories.summary: President Trump's upcoming visit to China is being closely watched by U.S. business leaders and policymakers for signs of stabilization in Washington-Beijing relations. The trip takes place amid the Iran war and tensions linked to the Strait of Hormuz, though expectations for major breakthroughs remain low.

stories.title: France arrests Tunisian suspected of planning 'jihad-inspired' attack in Paris
stories.summary: French authorities arrested a 27-year-old Tunisian man suspected of planning jihadism-inspired attacks in Paris. Sources said his targets included a Paris museum and members of the Jewish community.

stories.title: Costa Rica Profile
stories.summary: Costa Rica, traditionally seen as a secure country in Central America, has experienced record violence linked to its growing role as a drug transshipment hub. Authorities warn that local crime groups' increasing ties to transnational criminal organizations may deepen corruption and instability.

stories.title: HEC launches online degree attestation system to facilitate students
stories.summary: Pakistan's Higher Education Commission (HEC) launched a fully online and paperless degree attestation system. The initiative integrates blockchain technology and follows demands from a National Assembly committee to reduce processing times for degree verification.

stories.title: Former Anti-Corruption Foundation director says Team Navalny’s leadership has abandoned its core principles
stories.summary: Ivan Zhdanov, former director of Russia's Anti-Corruption Foundation (FBK), gave an interview criticizing the organization's current leadership for abandoning its core principles. He also described how he organized the transfer of Alexei Navalny's biological samples to Western laboratories, which confirmed the politician was poisoned.

stories.title: From local election loss to Mandelson fiasco, Starmer must go
stories.summary: Labour's poor performance in UK local elections and controversy over Peter Mandelson's appointment have raised serious questions about Prime Minister Keir Starmer's leadership and political judgment.

stories.title: In double trouble: Iran’s oil crisis – opinion
stories.summary: An opinion piece argues that Iran's oil sector is under severe pressure, suggesting the Islamic Republic should heed historical warnings that economic collapse often begins with such indicators.

stories.title: How rumours of ‘genital shrinking’ triggered panic and mob violence in Congo
stories.summary: The WHO-backed Africa Infodemic Response Alliance later linked at least 17 killings to the rumours, though some incidents could not be independently verified

stories.title: Iran warns of ‘well-deserved response to any aggression'
stories.summary: Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned that Iran's armed forces are prepared to deliver a "well-deserved response to any aggression," as tensions with the United States escalated following Trump's remarks that the ceasefire was on "life support."

stories.title: Air Assault Forces training center identifies key problem among mobilized recruits during intensive training
stories.summary: Ukraine's 199th Training Center of the Air Assault Forces reported that chronic health conditions going undetected during military medical exams are a major problem among mobilized recruits. The issue was identified during intensive training programs for newly conscripted personnel.

stories.title: Lawsuit blames ChatGPT maker OpenAI for helping plan Florida university shooting
stories.summary: The widow of a victim killed in last year's mass shooting at Florida State University has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI. Authorities disclosed that ChatGPT provided the shooter with advice on timing, location, and weapons to maximize casualties.

stories.title: EU imposes sanctions on Russia individuals, entities in Russia over Ukrainian children
stories.summary: BRUSSELS, May 11 - The European Union has imposed sanctions on 16 individuals and seven entities in Russia for systematic unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children, the EU Council said in a statement

stories.title: Iran and the U.S. are at an impasse ahead of Trump’s China trip
stories.summary: Iran and the United States have reached an impasse again over how to end their war

stories.title: Sybiha, Rutte discuss ways to scale up Ukrainian arms manufacturing with NATO support
stories.summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte met in Brussels to discuss scaling up arms manufacturing in Ukraine. The talks focused on leveraging NATO's industrial base to boost Ukrainian weapons production capacity.

stories.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
stories.summary: The European Union approved sanctions targeting Israeli settlers accused of violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. EU foreign policy chief stated that extremism carries consequences, while Israel condemned the measures as arbitrary.

stories.title: Italy's Culture Ministry rocked by dismissals as Meloni struggles to reshape landscape
stories.summary: ROME, May 11 - Italy's Culture Minister Alessandro Giuli has sacked two senior aides after uproar over denied funding for a documentary, adding to turbulence at a ministry already shaken by months of

stories.title: Ben Gurion operating like ‘a US military base’, Israel aviation chief warns
stories.summary: Israel's civil aviation chief Shmuel Zakay warned that Ben Gurion Airport is functioning like a US military base, raising concerns about disruptions to civilian flights and the return of foreign airlines to Israeli airspace.

stories.title: As Hungary’s new PM, Magyar’s hunt for Orban’s protégés has already begun
stories.summary: New Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar immediately called on the country's president to resign upon taking office on Saturday. The move signals Magyar's intent to dismantle former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán's network of loyalists throughout Hungarian institutions.

stories.title: EU ministers agree on sanctions targeting violent West Bank settlers
stories.summary: EU foreign ministers agreed on new sanctions targeting three violent Israeli settlers and four settler organizations in the occupied West Bank, as well as leading Hamas figures. The package had been blocked for months by Hungary's previous government, which lost power in a recent election.

stories.title: Pakistan protests to Afghanistan over suicide attack that killed 15 officers
stories.summary: Pakistan has summoned a senior Afghan diplomat to protest a suicide attack in its northwest that killed 15 police officers

stories.title: Pro-Palestine camp to take place at site of Jewish WWII deportations
stories.summary: A pro-Palestine encampment is planned at Moorweide in Hamburg, Germany, a historic site from which approximately 6,000 Jews, Sinti, and Roma were deported during the Holocaust.

stories.title: One million US dollars in federal grants awarded to California Jewish security initiative
stories.summary: US Congressman Brad Sherman secured one million dollars in federal grants for a California Jewish community security initiative, having originally requested $1.4 million from the House Appropriations Committee for fiscal year 2026.

stories.title: Hundreds of millions seized in raid in northern Israel
stories.summary: Israeli authorities seized hundreds of millions of shekels in a raid in northern Israel. The suspects were detained by the National Economic Crimes Unit on suspicion of money laundering and terror financing.

stories.title: Ukraine has built world’s most battle-tested defense industry. Berlin plugs in with “Brave Germany”
stories.summary: Germany and Ukraine signed a joint defense technology program called "Brave Germany," with Berlin already funding approximately one-third of Ukraine's defense production efforts.

stories.title: Trump to visit China for high-stakes talks with Xi Jinping
stories.summary: President Donald Trump is scheduled to visit China from May 13 to 15 for talks with President Xi Jinping. Trade, the Iran conflict, and regional security are expected to dominate the agenda.

stories.title: Lawsuit seeks to halt Trump's makeover of Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool
stories.summary: The Cultural Landscape Foundation filed a lawsuit to block President Trump's renovation of the Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool in Washington, D.C. The suit alleges the project violates the National Historic Preservation Act of 1996.

stories.title: Birmingham jury fails to convict pro-Palestine activist accused of supporting Hamas
stories.summary: A jury at Birmingham Crown Court was unable to convict Palestinian activist Majid Freeman, also known as Majid Novsarka, on charges of encouraging terrorism and supporting Hamas based on social media posts. A retrial has been ordered.

stories.title: Two held in Sweden over suspected deliveries of hi-tech gear to Russia
stories.summary: STOCKHOLM, May 11 - Two people have been detained in Sweden on suspicion of helping Russia procure advanced engineering products that could be used in Moscow's war in Ukraine, the Swedish security ser

stories.title: Could the latest violence in DR Congo undermine truce efforts?
stories.summary: Lesser-known armed groups have carried out a series of attacks in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The violence raises concerns about whether ongoing truce efforts in the country could be undermined.

stories.title: Russia intensifies FPV drone attacks in Southern Ukraine, military spox says
stories.summary: Russian forces significantly escalated combat operations in southern Ukraine last week, conducting nearly 200 assault attacks. The military reported a sharp increase in the use of kamikaze and first-person-view (FPV) drones in the region.

stories.title: Trump says he will discuss arms sales to Taiwan in meeting with China’s Xi
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump stated he plans to discuss arms sales to Taiwan during an upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Washington's weapons sales to Taipei have long been a source of friction with Beijing, which claims Taiwan as its territory.

stories.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli West Bank settlers, Hamas leaders
stories.summary: The European Union reached agreement on sanctions targeting both Israeli West Bank settlers and Hamas leaders. The deal was made possible after Hungary's newly installed government dropped the veto that had previously blocked the measures.

stories.title: Iraqi PM-designate caught between US endorsement, militia violence - report
stories.summary: Iraq's prime minister-designate Ali al-Zaidi faces pressure from the United States to exclude Iran-backed militias from his potential government. Reports indicate that such a move could provoke violent pushback from those armed groups.

stories.title: Why Iran's ballistic missiles pose a greater threat than the nuclear issue - analysis
stories.summary: An analysis highlights that Iran's ballistic missile capabilities may pose a greater immediate threat than its nuclear program. Iran reportedly surprised both Israel and the United States by rapidly excavating and restoring underground missile sites that had been bombed.

stories.title: Air Force MQ-9 downs aerial targets with cheap air-to-air missiles
stories.summary: The US Air Force demonstrated an MQ-9 Reaper drone shooting down aerial targets using low-cost air-to-air missiles. The test is part of the service's effort to develop affordable defenses against inexpensive enemy drones.

stories.title: NA passes unanimous resolution hailing military's 'befitting response' to India in May conflict
stories.summary: Pakistan's National Assembly unanimously passed a resolution praising the armed forces' response to India's military aggression during the May 2025 conflict. The conflict, spanning from the April 22 Pahalgam attack through the May 10 ceasefire, has been officially designated "Marka-i-Haq" by the Pakistani state.

stories.title: Report: Ukraine proposes splitting military recruitment offices, setting fixed service terms
stories.summary: Ukraine is considering proposals to restructure its military recruitment offices and establish fixed service terms. The discussions follow President Zelensky's replacement of the defense minister with Mykhailo Fedorov in January 2026 and a promised major stage of army reform announced in May.

stories.title: 'Macron always been a strong believer in the importance of Africa as a partner for the future'
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron is co-hosting the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi, Kenya, marking the first time France has held such an event in an English-speaking African nation. Chatham House fellow Paul Melly described it as part of a longer strategic effort to rebalance France's engagement beyond its traditional Francophone partners following setbacks in the Sahel.

stories.title: Ukraine is preparing military contracts with guaranteed demobilization rights and combat pay up to $9,100 per month
stories.summary: Ukraine is preparing new military contracts that would offer combat pay of up to $9,100 per month and guaranteed demobilization rights, representing a significant potential reform for soldiers mobilized since 2022.

stories.title: World losing 100 million barrels a week of oil with Hormuz closed, Saudi Aramco chief says
stories.summary: Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser warned that the closure of the Strait of Hormuz is costing the world approximately 100 million barrels of oil per week, citing a disconnect between oil futures prices and physical supply realities.

stories.title: South Africa: Johannesburg Faces a Total Financial Collapse While Executive Pay Soars
stories.summary: South Africa's Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana warned that the City of Johannesburg is in financial crisis and cannot fulfill a R10 billion wage deal with the Samwu labor union, effectively confirming the city's bankruptcy.

stories.title: Ukraine, Germany working on six joint weapons production projects – Zelensky
stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky and German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius discussed six joint weapons production projects between Ukraine and Germany. The talks also covered a long-term Drone Deal and German support for Ukraine's air defense and energy infrastructure.

stories.title: The US is ignoring Iran’s religious agenda at its own peril - opinion
stories.summary: An opinion piece argues that the Trump administration is underestimating Iran's religious motivations, specifically the influence of Twelver Shia theology on the country's ruling elite. The author warns that failing to account for this ideological dimension undermines U.S. policy.

stories.title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation coverage of Gaza war fueled antisemitism, ABC Watch claims
stories.summary: ABC Watch alleged that the Australian Broadcasting Corporation's coverage of the Gaza war contributed to rising antisemitism in Australia. The group argued the publicly funded broadcaster has a legal obligation to report impartially and objectively.

stories.title: Netanyahu defends Mossad chief pick after reportedly blasting Barnea for opposition
stories.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended his nomination of Roman Gofman as the next Mossad chief, suggesting that opposition to the pick, including reportedly from outgoing chief David Barnea, stemmed from political considerations rather than qualifications.

stories.title: EU ministers reject Putin's idea of role for Schroeder in future security talks
stories.summary: BRUSSELS, May 11 - European governments on Monday rejected suggestion by Russian President Vladimir Putin that German former Chancellor Gerhard Schroeder could represent them in possible future talks

stories.title: Saab launches new Carl-Gustaf, air defense munitions, expands production in US, India
stories.summary: Swedish defense company Saab announced new Carl-Gustaf warheads and air defense munitions. The firm also provided delivery timeline details for production facilities it is expanding in the United States and India.

stories.title: Israeli soldiers jailed for desecration of Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
stories.summary: Two Israeli soldiers were sentenced to military prison for desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary in southern Lebanon, where one placed a cigarette in the statue's mouth while the other photographed it. The viral image sparked widespread outrage over anti-Christian acts by Israeli forces.

stories.title: Bosnian Serb jailed for wartime killing of Muslims
stories.summary: Dusko Zoric, a Bosnian Serb, was convicted and jailed for killing five Muslims during the 1990s Bosnian war. He was extradited from Germany in 2025 to face justice.

stories.title: Lithuania backs Strait of Hormuz mission with just 40 troops
stories.summary: Lithuania's State Defence Council approved deploying up to 40 personnel, including troops and civilian defence staff, to join an international mission protecting shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The decision was confirmed by the president's office on Monday.

stories.title: Ukraine anti-corruption agencies serve suspicion notice to ex-Presidential Office head Yermak over alleged $10M laundering
stories.summary: Ukraine's National Anti-Corruption Bureau and Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office served a formal suspicion notice to Andriy Yermak, former head of the Presidential Office, over an alleged $10 million money laundering scheme.

stories.title: EU and UK sanction organizers of militarization of Ukrainian children in occupied territories
stories.summary: The United Kingdom and the European Union imposed new sanctions on Russian organizations and officials accused of Russifying and militarizing Ukrainian children in occupied territories. The measures also target individuals coordinating Russian information operations.

stories.title: Exclusive: Emmanuel Macron interview on FRANCE 24, Tuesday May 12 at 9pm
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron will give an interview to FRANCE 24, RFI, and TV5Monde journalists in Nairobi, Kenya, on Tuesday, May 12, following the conclusion of the Africa Forward Summit.

stories.title: Kenya summit represents 'demarcation point': France 'wants to do business' with African continent
stories.summary: President Emmanuel Macron and Kenyan President William Ruto co-hosted the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi. Analysts describe the event as a turning point for French diplomacy in Africa, as Paris seeks to redefine its continental role after military ruptures in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger and growing Russian and Chinese influence.

stories.title: Iranian protesters accosted by pro-Palestinian mobs
stories.summary: Kosar Eftekhari, an Iranian woman who lost an eye after being shot by the Iranian regime, was attacked by pro-regime protesters during a demonstration in Germany. The incident highlights tensions between Iranian diaspora protesters and regime supporters abroad.

stories.title: Iron Dome nearly 99% effective against incoming missiles, maker Rafael's chairman says
stories.summary: Rafael Advanced Defense Systems chairman stated that Israel's Iron Dome missile defense system has achieved nearly 99% effectiveness against missiles fired by Hamas and Hezbollah. The system has also intercepted most missiles launched from Iran.

stories.title: EU foreign ministers approve sanctions on violent Israeli settlers, Hamas leaders
stories.summary: EU foreign ministers approved sanctions targeting violent Israeli settlers and Hamas leaders after Hungary's new leadership lifted its longstanding veto on the measure. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar rejected the decision.

stories.title: India expects the U.S. team to visit India for next round of trade talks, say officials
stories.summary: India and the U.S. issued a joint statement on February 7 finalising a framework for an interim trade agreement regarding reciprocal and mutually beneficial trade

stories.title: Trump vows to pause federal gas tax after Iran war boosts US fuel prices to four-year high
stories.summary: President Trump pledged to suspend the federal gas tax after U.S. fuel prices reached a four-year high. The national average has risen by over a dollar per gallon since late February, when U.S. and Israeli forces launched military operations against Iran.

stories.title: Elon Musk and Tim Cook among CEOs expected to accompany Trump on China trip
stories.summary: Seventeen US corporate executives, including Elon Musk and Apple CEO Tim Cook, are expected to accompany President Trump on his trip to China. The delegation will attend meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

stories.title: UK sanctions network accused of planning attacks for Iran
stories.summary: The United Kingdom imposed asset freezes and travel bans on a network accused of laundering billions of dollars and planning hostile operations on behalf of Iran on British soil.

stories.title: Imaan, Hadi submit additional documents ahead of hearing on appeals in apex court tomorrow
stories.summary: ISLAMABAD: Human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, have submitted additional documents to the Supreme Court of Pakistan, bringing these on record before the he

stories.title: Philippine senator flees ICC arrest over role in Duterte’s drug war
stories.summary: Philippine Senator Ronald Dela Rosa evaded arrest on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court related to his role in former President Rodrigo Duterte's drug war campaign.

stories.title: Germany views Putin’s Schröder ceasefire proposal part of Russia’s hybrid strategy aimed at dividing West. It could consider him on one condition
stories.summary: German officials dismissed former Chancellor Gerhard Schröder's ceasefire proposal on behalf of Russian President Vladimir Putin, viewing it as part of Russia's hybrid strategy aimed at dividing Western allies.

stories.title: Ben Gvir calls EU ‘antisemitic’ as bloc sanctions Israeli settlers
stories.summary: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir accused the European Union of antisemitism after the bloc imposed sanctions on Israeli settlers linked to violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. Ben Gvir dismissed the EU's actions as biased.

stories.title: SC dismisses appeals against SHC order in TRG shareholding dispute
stories.summary: The Supreme Court (SC) on Monday dismissed a set of appeals instituted by Greentree Holdings Limited (GTH) against a June order by the Sindh High Court (SHC), which had held that GTH shares were the p

stories.title: Bolivia’s Evo Morales held in contempt after missing court in trafficking trial
stories.summary: A Bolivian judge held former President Evo Morales in contempt after he failed to appear in court for his trial on charges of trafficking a minor. Morales, who served as Bolivia's first indigenous president from 2006 to 2019, is accused of having a relationship with a teenager during his presidency.

stories.title: From “drone killers” to virtual reality: Air Assault Forces reveal new standards in troop training
stories.summary: The 199th Training Center of the Ukrainian Air Assault Forces has incorporated virtual reality and computer simulation technologies into its training programs. The technologies are being used during basic combined-arms training and specialized instruction for troops.

stories.title: Zelenskiy says some 20 countries interested in drone deals with Ukraine
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that nearly 20 countries have expressed interest in drone deals with Ukraine, with four agreements already signed. The announcement underscores Ukraine's growing role as a drone technology exporter.

stories.title: Drug gang attacks ‘force hundreds of Indigenous families to flee’ in Mexico
stories.summary: In Guerrero state, Mexico, the criminal group Los Ardillos has intensified attacks on Indigenous communities, including drone bombings. The National Indigenous Congress reported that between 800 and 1,000 families were forced to flee their mountain villages after hours of sustained bombardment.

stories.title: Woman arrested for allegedly attacking London Jewish school boy
stories.summary: A woman was arrested in London for allegedly punching a Jewish schoolboy and shouting antisemitic abuse during the attack. The incident was reported by the Jewish neighborhood watch group Shomrim on social media.

stories.title: Trump says ceasefire with Iran on ‘life support’ after rejecting peace proposals
stories.summary: President Donald Trump declared the ceasefire with Iran is on "life support" and rejected Iranian peace proposals. He said he is considering restarting U.S. Navy escorts of ships through the Strait of Hormuz to counter an Iranian blockade of the strategic waterway.

stories.title: How impunity in Shireen Abu Akleh’s case fuels Israeli attacks on the press
stories.summary: Rights advocates argue that the lack of accountability for the 2022 killing of Al Jazeera journalist and US citizen Shireen Abu Akleh by Israeli forces has emboldened further attacks on press freedom.

stories.title: What local elections reveal about the future of UK politics
stories.summary: Recent UK local election results revealed growing fragmentation of British politics, with the traditional two-party system weakening. Reform UK and the Green Party made gains, filling the vacuum left by declining support for Labour and the Conservatives.

stories.title: Turkey's foreign minister to visit Qatar for talks on Iran war
stories.summary: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan will visit Qatar on Tuesday for talks on the Iran war and its regional impact. Discussions will also address efforts to ensure navigational safety in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Israel's Knesset backs 'show trial' bill to try 7 Oct defendants
stories.summary: Israel's Knesset passed a bill enabling public trials of defendants connected to the October 7 attacks, with possible death sentences. Rights monitors warned the proceedings could violate international law and amount to show trials.

stories.title: Israel's Knesset backs 'show trial' bill to try 7 Oct attackers
stories.summary: Israel's Knesset approved legislation to publicly try captured October 7 attackers in military tribunals. Human rights organizations have warned that public trials and possible death sentences could violate international law and amount to show trials.

stories.title: Israel votes on controversial public trial bill for Palestinians
stories.summary: The Israeli Knesset voted on a bill that would allow public trials of Palestinian detainees. Human rights organizations including Adalah warned the legislation could violate international law and represent a collapse of the rule of law.

stories.title: PM extends austerity drive till June 13 to deal with impact of Middle East war
stories.summary: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif extended nationwide austerity measures until June 13 to address the economic impact of the Middle East conflict. The measures were first introduced on March 9 in response to a global oil crisis triggered by US-Israeli attacks on Iran beginning February 28.

stories.title: Maldives repays second $50mn Indian treasury bill: President Mohamed Muizzu
stories.summary: India had extended financial support to the Maldives through treasury bills, also called T-Bills, subscribed by the State Bank of India

stories.title: Sudan drone strikes killed at least 880 civilians between January and April: UN
stories.summary: The South Sudan Civil War is entering a deadlier phase, says UN rights chief

stories.title: US op. in Iran would expand beyond escorting vessels in Strait of Hormuz, Trump says
stories.summary: President Trump indicated that a potential U.S. military operation involving Iran could expand beyond escorting vessels through the Strait of Hormuz. He reiterated that the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is on 'life support.'

stories.title: Trump dismisses Iran’s reply to peace plan, oil jumps as Hormuz closure persists
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Iran's response to a peace proposal, causing oil prices to jump. Tehran had demanded compensation for war damage and asserted sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz as part of its response.

stories.title: Buk, Tor, Kasta, Tunguska—Russia’s air defense menu shrinks by $131 million in another seven days
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone forces destroyed an estimated $131 million worth of Russian air defense systems, including Buk, Tor, Kasta, and Tunguska platforms, across occupied Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Russia's Bryansk Oblast in one week.

stories.title: Border guards prevent Russian small assault groups from breaking through in Kharkiv region
stories.summary: Fighters of Ukraine's Hart Border Brigade repelled an attempt by Russian small assault groups to infiltrate positions in the Southern Slobozhanshchyna direction in Kharkiv region. The border guards prevented the Russian forces from breaking through.

stories.title: Israeli strikes hit south Lebanon, killing three and wounding four
stories.summary: Israeli forces carried out multiple strikes across southern Lebanon, killing at least three people and wounding four. A health facility in Srifa was directly struck, killing one, while a drone attack on a vehicle in Doueir killed two others.

stories.title: Trump says ceasefire is on ‘life support’ after rejecting Iran’s proposal
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump declared the ceasefire negotiations with Iran to be on "life support" after rejecting Tehran's latest counterproposal, which he deemed unacceptable.

stories.title: Three ministerial aides quit and demand Keir Starmer’s resignation as speech fails to quell rebellion – UK politics live
stories.summary: Three ministerial aides in the UK resigned and called on Prime Minister Keir Starmer to step down following poor Labour performance in local elections. More than 60 Labour MPs have demanded Starmer set a timetable for his resignation. The rebellion continued despite a speech by the prime minister attempting to reassure his party.

stories.title: Navy unveils three new PAEs for aviation, mission systems, munitions
stories.summary: The US Navy established three new Program and Acquisition Executive offices covering aviation, mission systems, and munitions portfolios. Jason Potter, performing the duties of assistant secretary of the Navy for research and development, said the new PAEs will accelerate acquisition efforts in these key areas.

stories.title: Europe must establish direct contact with Russia — Stubb
stories.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb stated that European governments should establish direct contact with Moscow. Stubb believes the time has come for Europe to engage directly with Russia.

stories.title: UN warns drone attacks drive surge in civilian deaths in Sudan
stories.summary: The UN human rights chief warned that widening violence in Sudan and the increasing use of drones are driving a surge in civilian deaths. The escalation could lead to further displacement across the conflict-affected country.

stories.title: Sensationalism Doesn’t Serve Society
stories.summary: The Ukraine Compass, a weekly digest for War on the Rocks members, curates commentary and analysis from Ukrainian media to provide perspectives beyond battlefield coverage. The series highlights how Ukrainians themselves debate political, social, and daily-life issues while their country remains at war.

stories.title: EU hits Israel settlers with new sanctions over W. Bank violence
stories.summary: The European Union approved new sanctions targeting Israeli settler groups and individuals accused of perpetrating violence against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. The measures aim to address escalating settler attacks in the territory.

stories.title: North Korea Has Reaped $13Bln From Military Aid to Russia, South Korean Intelligence Says
stories.summary: South Korean intelligence reports that North Korea has received an estimated $13 billion in benefits from military aid provided to Russia. Pyongyang allegedly received hard currency, energy supplies, and critical military technologies in exchange for weapons and manpower, helping bypass international sanctions.

stories.title: Poland says its expects US to extradite ex-minister who fled from Hungary
stories.summary: Poland's foreign minister Radosław Sikorski stated that Warsaw expects the United States to extradite former Polish justice minister Zbigniew Ziobro, who is wanted on criminal charges. Ziobro reportedly fled to the US from Hungary, where former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán had granted him asylum. President Trump was reportedly involved in securing Ziobro's US visa.

stories.title: UK slaps sanctions on dozen people and entities deemed ‘criminal proxies’ of Iran
stories.summary: The United Kingdom imposed sanctions on 12 individuals and entities described as criminal proxies of Iran. The measures follow a wave of arson attacks allegedly backed by Tehran targeting Jewish sites in London.

stories.title: 5 US bases selected for anti-drone pilot program
stories.summary: The US military has selected five installations for a pilot program testing anti-drone directed-energy systems. Two of the chosen bases are located along the southern border. The program aims to counter the growing threat posed by unmanned aerial systems at military facilities.

stories.title: Turkey’s STM debuts new unmanned systems, is ‘really open’ to Gulf collaboration
stories.summary: Turkish defense firm STM unveiled new unmanned systems and expressed openness to collaboration with Gulf states. The company's general manager said STM is already integrating artificial intelligence, image processing, and machine learning into its platforms and is deepening its investment in those technologies.

stories.title: Newly elected Reform councillor resigns after social media claims
stories.summary: Stuart Prior, a newly elected Reform UK councillor in Essex, resigned days after winning his seat following allegations about his social media posts. He allegedly celebrated the rape of a Sikh woman, declared white people the "master race," and called Muslim people "rats." Prior had received 2,404 votes, the highest total of any candidate in his ward.
