stories.summary: European NATO allies pushed back against a reported US threat directed at Spain, further straining transatlantic relations. BBC Europe editor Katya Adler reported the incident highlighted ongoing tensions between Europe and the United States.

stories.title: Iran war live: Tehran’s FM in Islamabad; US says envoys to travel for talks
stories.summary: Israeli air strikes and tank shelling across Gaza killed at least 12 Palestinians, including six police officers, according to reports from the territory.

stories.title: Leo Terrell’s civil rights roots fuel his fight against antisemitism
stories.summary: Leo Terrell, who leads a federal task force targeting antisemitism, described the fight against threats to the Jewish community as personally important to him, drawing on his civil rights background.

stories.title: Thousands at risk after multi-million dollar Everest flood warning system left to rust
stories.summary: A multi-million-dollar flood warning system installed at Imja glacial lake near Mount Everest has not been maintained since 2016. Local residents expressed fear about the risk to thousands of people living downstream from the deteriorating system in Nepal.

stories.title: Police raid Peru’s election authorities after outcry over slow vote count
stories.summary: Anticorruption police in Peru raided the homes of former election office head Piero Corvetto and other officials, seizing material amid public outcry over a slow vote count following recent elections.

stories.title: Syria accuses Hezbollah-linked cells of plotting attacks, signaling break from Assad-era alliance
stories.summary: Syria's post-Assad government accused Hezbollah-linked cells of plotting assassinations, bombings, and rocket attacks on Syrian territory. Damascus is moving against these networks, signaling a break from the former Assad regime's alliance with Hezbollah.

stories.title: “Make Iran Ungovernable” – Tracking Efforts To Destroy Iran’s Police Infrastructure
stories.summary: Bellingcat has identified at least 80 police stations or infrastructure related to law enforcement agencies and the Basij paramilitary group that has been damaged or destroyed in the first three weeks

stories.title: Mining China’s ‘Little Red Book’ for Open Source Gold
stories.summary: The challenges of conducting open-source research in China are well-documented. Consistently named one of the most digitally oppressive countries in the world, China blocks some of the world’s largest

stories.summary: This article is the result of a collaboration with Indian media outlet Newslaundry. You can find Newslaundry’s editorially independent coverage here. Indian companies have shipped more than 320 millio

stories.title: The human cost of the war in Sudan, three years on
stories.summary: The conflict, which erupted in 2023, has left behind a human toll which is "simply staggering", reports the BBC's Barbara Plett Usher.

stories.title: When Satellite Imagery Goes Dark: New Tool Shows Damage in Iran and the Gulf
stories.summary: Access to open source visuals of the current Iran conflict, which has spread to many parts of the Middle East, continues to be sporadic. Videos and photos from within Iran trickle out on social media

stories.summary: Bellingcat has identified several high-profile incidents where authorities in the United Arab Emirates have downplayed damage, mischaracterised interceptions and in some instances not acknowledged suc

stories.title: From the front lines to the future: Israeli society and the Jewish people in 2036
stories.summary: Speaking at the Jerusalem Post Miami Conference, IDF veterans and civil-society leaders highlighted service, dignity, and Diaspora responsibility as pillars of Israel’s next chapter.

stories.title: How TALMA turns English education into social mobility and a Zionist mission
stories.summary: At the Jerusalem Post Miami Conference, TALMA CEO Ido Mahatzri showed how teachers, language and values reshape Israel’s periphery.

stories.title: 'Over 90% of Iranians hate the regime,' INSS’s Beni Sabti reveals from leaked Iran survey
stories.summary: “It was a secret poll which said that 92% of the Iranian people hate their regime,” Sabti said, according to a transcript provided to The Jerusalem Post.

stories.title: Alshareef: Israel, Jews, should help Iranians seek liberty to ‘repay debt to Cyrus’
stories.summary: Speaking at the Jerusalem Post Miami Summit on Wednesday, Alshareef called on Israel and the Jewish people to back Iranians seeking freedom, as Netanyahu voiced solidarity with the protesters.

stories.title: Watch: The Jerusalem Post Miami Summit
stories.summary: Amid changing geopolitics and evolving Diaspora-Israel relations, the conference served as a platform for powerful ideas, bold discussions, and building bridges across continents.
